title: Modern Website Developer & Designer (WordPress, Webflow, Framer, AI Builders)
description:
???? About MVM Management

MVM Management is a California-based operations and brand support company managing multiple websites across our businesses and clients. We value:



✨ Consistency

✨ Clear communication

✨ Daily accountability

✨ Continuous learning

✨ Proactive improvement

✨ Modern, clean, functional design



We use ClickUp for daily task management and provide AI tools to support faster workflows, better design, SEO improvements, and modern development practices.



???? Role Overview

We are hiring a Modern Website Developer & Designer who can work across multiple platforms — not just WordPress.

You must be able to maintain our existing WordPress sites and help us build modern, high-performance websites using:



* Webflow

* Framer

* Render

* Wix Studio (optional)

* Squarespace Fluid Engine (optional)

* AI-assisted builders (Durable, 10Web, Framer AI, Wix ADI)

* Spotify



We want someone who is curious, innovative, and eager to learn new technologies — someone who brings new ideas, not just executes tasks.



This is a long-term, growth-oriented position with salary increases based on performance, innovation, communication, and alignment with company values.



???? Key Responsibilities:

????️ Website Development & Design (Multi-Platform)

*Build, update, and maintain websites using WordPress + Elementor

* Build or learn to build in Webflow, Framer, Render, Wix Studio, Squarespace Fluid Engine

* Explore and test AI-assisted site builders

* Improve layouts, UI/UX, and overall site performance

* Create new pages, sections, and design elements

* Maintain consistent branding across all websites



???? Website Maintenance

* Weekly updates: plugins, themes, WordPress core

* Test new plugins, features, and strategies

* Troubleshoot layout issues, plugin conflicts, and speed problems

* Ensure mobile responsiveness across all pages



???? SEO & Performance Optimization

* Execute on-page SEO strategies (meta tags, alt text, schema, etc.)

* Improve site speed using caching, compression, and optimization tools

* Maintain SEO health using RankMath, Yoast, or AIOSEO

* Support content formatting for SEO



???? Content & Site Management

*Upload blogs, images, and media following SEO guidelines

* Keep all sites updated with fresh content

* Suggest improvements, new features, and modern design trends

* Maintain clean, organized site structures

* Backup Sites



???? Technology Innovation & Research

You must stay ahead of modern web development trends, including:

* Webflow

* Framer

* Render

* Headless WordPress (React/Next.js)

* AI-assisted builders

* Modern hosting platforms

* New theme builders and frameworks

* We want someone who actively brings new tools, ideas, and strategies to the team.



???? Daily Reporting & Communication

* Daily check-ins through ClickUp

* Daily progress report (tasks completed, issues found, next steps)

* Clear communication with leadership

* Ability to follow structured workflows and company values



???? AI Tool Integration

* Use AI tools provided by MVM Management to:

* Speed up content formatting

* Improve SEO

* Generate design ideas

* Support troubleshooting

* Enhance productivity



???? Required Skills

* Strong experience with WordPress + Elementor

* Ability to build or willingness to learn Webflow, Framer, Render, Wix Studio, Squarespace Fluid Engine

* Understanding of modern web development trends

* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals

* Experience with website speed optimization

* Familiarity with plugin ecosystems

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent communication skills

* Ability to follow structured workflows and daily reporting



???? Bonus Skills (Highly Preferred)

* Experience with headless CMS (Strapi, Sanity, Ghost)

* Basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript

* Experience with website security tools

* Familiarity with Google Search Console & Analytics

* Ability to create simple graphics (Canva, Photoshop)

* Experience with AI-assisted builders (Durable, 10Web, Framer AI)



???? Modern Web Development Mindset

You must be someone who is:

???? Curious

???? Eager to learn

???? Excited about new technology

???? Able to adapt to new platforms

???? Ready to help us evolve beyond WordPress



???? Growth Path

* Salary increases based on performance

* Opportunities to learn modern web technologies

* Expanded responsibilities as skills grow

* Long-term stability



???? Paid Trial Week

We conduct a 1-week paid trial to evaluate:

* Skill level

* Communication

* Daily reporting consistency

* Ability to follow instructions

* Alignment with our team values

* Successful candidates are hired full-time.



YOU WILL REQUIRE a VIDEO Interview. When you reach out start by answering this question FIRST: Where would you like to visit in the Philippines?

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels) — Talking Head + Heavy Visual Overlays, AI/Automation Niche
description:
[IMPORTANT: READ THE WHOLE POST. Applications that skip the 5 questions get no reply.]



**About the Role**



I'm Dusty. I run YouTube and Instagram channels about AI tools, automation, and crypto trading. I record myself talking to camera. That is all I do. Everything else — the b-roll, the screen recordings, the text pops, the memes, the zooms, the graphics — is your job.



I am hiring one editor to own that visual layer.



**The Style (watch these before you apply)**



These accounts are exactly what I want:















Watch a few reels from each. Notice what they have in common: a person talking, and something on screen for almost every sentence. App UIs, screen recordings, cursor movement, arrows, highlighted text, quick memes, punchy captions. The talking head is the spine. You build the body.



If you have never made an edit that looks like that, this is not the job for you.



**What You Do**



* Get a raw take from me: one person talking to camera, 60 to 180 seconds, one file, with the umms and the restarts still in it

* Cut it tight. Kill the dead air, the fumbles, the restarts. If a sentence drags, it goes

* Build the visual layer. Every claim gets something on screen: a screen recording of the tool, a UI shot, an arrow, a highlight, a chart, a meme, a text pop. You source or create these. I do not hand them to you

* Caption it. Clean, readable, on beat with the delivery. Not karaoke flicker

* Reframe to vertical 9:16 and deliver it ready to post

* Build the hook frame / cover image where one is needed

* Target: one finished reel per weekday to start, growing from there



**Where This Goes**



Once you are solid on reels, the role expands into long-form YouTube: 8 to 20 minute talking head plus screen recording videos in the same visual style, plus thumbnails. Pay goes up with it. I would rather grow one person than hire twice.



**What You Need to Be Good At**



* **Timeline editing** in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut. Tell me which one and how long you have used it

* **Motion graphics that do not look like a template.** Position, scale, and opacity keyframes at minimum. After Effects is a strong plus

* **Sourcing your own visuals.** You can find or record a screen capture of an AI tool, grab a clean UI shot, and pick a meme that actually lands

* **Pacing.** You know when a beat is dead and you cut it without being told

* **Captions** that read on a phone

* **English good enough to understand meaning, not just words.** You are d
 which visual matches a sentence about AI agents or a price chart

* **Daily reliability.** Same-day or next-day turnaround on one reel



**Nice to Have**



* You already follow AI tool, automation, or crypto content and know what n8n, Make, ChatGPT, Claude, or TradingView look like on screen

* You have edited for a personal brand before



**Pay**



Benchmarked against what comparable roles on this platform are paying this month.



* **Paid test task: $30 USD**, paid on delivery, pass or fail. One raw take, one finished reel

* **Trial week: $25 USD per finished reel**

* **Ongoing: $700 to $1,000 USD per month** full-time, based on the test and your experience

* **30-day review**, with a raise into the $1,000 to $1,300 range for strong, reliable work, and again when long-form is added

* Paid by Wise or GCash, your choice. Twice a month if you prefer



**How to Apply (answer all 5 — skip one and I do not reply)**



1. Which of the five accounts above is closest to work you have already made? Name it, then link the reel of yours that proves it.



2. Send 2 to 3 links to short-form videos you edited where the visuals are heavy: b-roll, screen recordings, graphics, memes. Not a showreel montage. Actual finished posts.



3. Pick any one of those. Tell me one visual you added that was not in the raw footage, and why you chose it. Two sentences.



4. What software do you use, and how many years?



5. What is your monthly rate in USD for full-time, and how many reels per week can you deliver at your best quality?



Start your message with the word REELS so I know you read this.



— Dusty

title: Travel Planning & Operations Assistant
description:
GMH Travel is a growing U.S.-based travel agency specializing in customized international travel, luxury FITs, honeymoons, groups, cruises, and complex multi-destination itineraries.



I am looking for an exceptionally detail-oriented Travel Planning & Operations Assistant to work directly with me.



This is not primarily an inbox-management, calendar-management, social-media, or Canva VA position.



The biggest need in my business is helping turn client trip ideas into thoroughly researched, accurate proposals and then executing the bookings once clients approve them.



What You Will Eventually Help With

Trip Research & Proposal Preparation

Research hotels, villas, transportation, trains, ferries, activities, tours, and other trip components.

Compare options based on location, quality, reviews, logistics, price, cancellation terms, and client profile.

Research destinations you may never have worked with before.

Build detailed trip-costing spreadsheets in Google Sheets.

Verify dates, travel times, room types, taxes, fees, commission, and cancellation policies.

Use Claude and other tools to help create detailed client proposals based on my direction and research.

Review AI-generated content carefully for inaccuracies or missing information.

Format and prepare client-facing proposals for my final review.

Booking & Trip Operations



After a client approves a trip:



Prepare documents for signature.

Prepare invoices and payment information.

Book approved hotels, transfers, ferries, trains, activities, and other components.

Download and organize confirmations.

Enter booking details into itinerary/CRM systems.

Upload confirmations and documents.

Verify every booking against the approved itinerary.

Track outstanding confirmations and follow up with suppliers.

Update actual trip costs and commissions after booking.

Internal Operations

Maintain accurate Google Sheets and tracking systems.

Assist with commission tracking and reconciliation.

Maintain vendor and supplier information.

Help organize CRM and travel systems such as Tern and Travefy.

Document recurring processes and create SOPs while learning the business.

Identify inefficient repetitive processes and suggest better ways to handle them.

Help implement simple workflow improvements and automations where appropriate.

The Person I Need



Attention to detail is the single most important requirement for this position.



A small error in travel can create a major problem. You must naturally check details multiple times.



You should be the type of person who notices:



A flight arrives at 9:45 AM but a transfer was booked for 9:45 PM.

An activity overlaps with a train departure.

A hotel room only accommodates two people when the family has three.

A rate excludes taxes even though another rate includes them.

A hotel looks beautiful but is 45 minutes away from where the clients actually need to be.

A cancellation policy changes depending on the room/rate selected.

The ferry arrives at a different port than the transfer company expects.



I am looking for someone who thinks before executing.



If instructions appear incorrect, incomplete, inefficient, or contradictory, I want you to stop and ask questions or suggest a better solution.



I do not want someone who simply says, “That is the policy” or follows a process they know is producing the wrong result.



I want someone who asks:



“What are we actually trying to accomplish, and is there a better way to accomplish it?”



At the same time, once something has been approved for booking, I need exact execution. Do not substitute hotels, rates, flights, activities, or other components without approval.



Required Skills

Exceptional attention to detail

Excellent written and reading comprehension in English

Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

Excellent online research skills

Strong organization and follow-through

Ability to compare large amounts of information accurately

Comfortable learning unfamiliar software

Ability to follow detailed instructions while still using judgment

Strong written communication with hotels, suppliers, and vendors

Comfortable working with AI tools such as Claude

Comfortable handling numbers, pricing, commissions, and basic financial calculations

Ability to manage multiple trips/projects at different stages without losing details



Experience in one or more of the following:



Custom travel planning / FIT travel

Tour operator or DMC operations

Luxury travel

Hotel or supplier contracting/reservations

Itinerary building

Travel agency operations

Travefy

Tern or another travel CRM

Google Workspace

CRM management

Zapier, Make, or other workflow automation tools

Basic bookkeeping / AP / AR



Travel-industry experience is helpful, but the right thinking style and level of diligence matter more than having worked at a large travel call center.



This Role Is Probably NOT For You If

Your primary experience is social media, graphic design, or Canva.

You prefer highly repetitive work with every step already documented.

You wait for instructions whenever something unexpected happens.

You are uncomfortable researching unfamiliar subjects independently.

You rush through details to complete tasks quickly.

You assume information is correct without verifying it.

You rely heavily on scripts.

You need an SOP for every possible situation before you can move forward.



This Role IS For You If

You enjoy research.

You love spreadsheets and organized information.

You naturally double-check your work.

You notice inconsistencies others miss.

You like solving logistical puzzles.

You enjoy improving systems.

You can learn patterns and apply them to new situations.

You take ownership of an outcome instead of only completing assigned steps.



Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with the potential to grow into a larger role if the fit is excellent.



Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be helpful, but much of the research and production work can be completed independently.



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Tell me about a process or workflow you inherited that was inefficient. What did you change and why?

Tell me about a time you caught an important error before it became a problem.

You are researching a hotel for a honeymoon couple. What specific things would you investigate before recommending it?

If I give you instructions that appear to conflict with each other, what do you do?

Which of these have you personally used: Google Sheets, Excel, Claude, ChatGPT, Travefy, Tern, travel CRMs, Zapier, Make, project-management software?

Describe the most complicated trip, project, booking, event, or logistical task you have personally coordinated.



Please begin your application with the words “DETAILS MATTER” so I know you read the entire posting.



Finalists will receive a paid practical test before hiring.

title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator - Real Estate
description:
Hi! I’m a Realtor in Florida, and I’m looking for a creative, reliable Social Media Manager & Content Creator to join me and help grow my real estate brand.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys social media and content creation, someone who notices a trending Reel or audio and immediately starts thinking about how we could put our own spin on it.



I’ll provide you with plenty of photos, videos, listing information, client reviews, real estate information, and ideas. I need someone who can take what I give them and turn it into beautiful, engaging content without needing step-by-step instructions for every post.



I also want this to be collaborative! If you have an idea and need something from me, tell me. If you think I should record a certain video, send me the idea or talking points and I’ll record it for you. I want someone who will bring ideas to the table and help me figure out what we should create next.



What You'll Help Me With



You’ll help create and manage content for my:



* Instagram

*
 personal & business pages

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* Google Business Profile

* X/Twitter



A big part of your role will be taking the photos and videos I send you and turning them into professional Reels, short-form videos, carousels, graphics, and posts.



Some weeks that might mean creating a Reel for a new luxury listing. Another week it might be a fun trending Reel, a local Citrus County post, a client success story, an educational carousel for sellers, a market update, or content that simply lets people get to know me.



I don't want my page to feel like one big real estate advertisement. I want to build a recognizable personal brand that people actually enjoy following.



You'd Be a Great Fit If You...



* Love creating Reels and short-form video

* Are very comfortable with Canva and CapCut or similar programs

* Have a great eye for clean, polished design

* Keep up with trending music, audio, Reel formats and social media trends

* Know how to create a strong hook that makes someone want to keep watching

* Can turn a folder of photos and random video clips into something that looks professional

* Can create beautiful carousels and graphics

* Write captions in excellent English

* Understand that Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn and Google Business shouldn't necessarily receive the exact same post

* Are creative and comfortable bringing your own ideas to me

* Pay attention to the little details

* Communicate well and meet deadlines

* Are open to feedback and revisions

* Want a long-term position where you can learn the brand and grow with the business



Real estate social media experience is definitely a plus, especially if you've worked with a U.S.-based Realtor or real estate company, but great content and creativity are what I really want to see.



The Look & Feel



My goal is for my brand to feel:



Luxury • Professional • Modern • Local • Approachable • Authentic



Think clean and sophisticated, but still personal and relatable.



I don't want generic Realtor templates or a feed filled with "JUST SOLD!" graphics. I want content that feels current, interesting and recognizable as my brand.



A Little About the Role



I'm looking for someone who can eventually take real ownership of my social media posts (I will stay connected to my followers and friends by responding to comments on my posts).



I don't expect you to know my business or my local market on day one. I'll help you learn both.



What I do want from the beginning is creativity, initiative and a willingness to learn.



If you see a trend that would be perfect for us, send it to me.



If you need a video from me, tell me what to record.



If you think we could turn one piece of content into five different posts, I want to hear your ideas.



The goal is for us to work together, not for me to hand you a list of exactly what to do every day.



How to Apply



I'd love to see what you've created!



Please
 your application and include:



* Your resume

* Your portfolio

* Links to social media accounts you've managed

* At least 3 Reels or short-form videos you've personally edited

* Examples of carousels or graphics you've created

* Any experience you have with real estate or U.S.-based clients

* The programs you use for video editing and content creation

* Your availability each week

* Your desired hourly rate or monthly salary



Please copy and paste the following into the subject line of your
:



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER – [YOUR FIRST NAME]



For example:



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER – MARIA



This helps me keep applications organized and lets me know which position you're applying for.



Most Importantly...



I'm hoping to find someone I really enjoy working with who wants to stick around and grow with me.



As my real estate business grows, I'd love for this role to grow too.



If you're creative, love social media, have a great eye for content, and are the kind of person who's always sending someone a Reel saying "We should do this!"—I'd love to hear from you.

Source, edit, resize, and optimize product images for web use (background removal, cropping, compression, consistent formatting)

Basic spreadsheet skills (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking inventory/uploads

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

Experience with bulk upload tools (CSV import/export, Matrixify, etc.)

Prior experience in dropshipping, fashion, beauty, or general retail e-commerce

Product listings are live, accurate, and error-free

Product descriptions are engaging, on-brand, and SEO-optimized

Daily/weekly listing quotas are consistently met

Minimal errors requiring correction after publishing

title: POTENTIAL Full Time Editor Needed- Tiktok Shop/Meta Ads
description:
# TikTok Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok Shop / UGC



I’m looking for a **high-level short-form video editor** who understands how to edit specifically for **TikTok retention, engagement, and conversions**.



This is **not** a traditional video editing position. I’m looking for someone who understands why people stop scrolling, what keeps them watching, and how editing can make a TikTok Shop video perform better.



## What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll primarily edit:



* TikTok Shop product videos

* UGC-style advertisements

* Beauty, skincare, haircare, grooming, and lifestyle content

* Talking-head videos

* Product demonstrations

* Before/after style content where appropriate

* 15–60 second short-form videos



I will usually provide the **raw footage and overall concept**. Your job is to turn that footage into a polished, high-retention TikTok.



## Creative References & Inspiration



I need an editor who is comfortable working from **video inspiration and references**.



I should be able to send you examples of TikToks, Reels, ads, or specific edits and say:



**“I want this video edited similar to this style.”**



You should be able to study the reference and understand things like:



* Pacing

* Caption style

* Cuts and transitions

* Zooms and punch-ins

* B-roll placement

* Sound effects

* Graphics

* Hook structure

* Overall editing energy and flow



You should be able to take inspiration from the reference **without simply copying it**, and adapt that editing style to my own footage and content.



The goal is for me to be able to send you **raw footage + a reference video + basic instructions**, and have you understand the direction without needing excessive back-and-forth.



## The Editing Style I Want



I want editing that feels **native to TikTok**, not like a traditional commercial.



You should understand how to use:



* Strong visual hooks within the first 1–3 seconds

* Fast, natural cuts that remove unnecessary pauses

* Pattern interrupts to maintain attention

* Strategic punch-ins and zooms

* Clean, readable on-screen text

* Attention-grabbing text hooks

* Dynamic captions

* B-roll and product close-ups

* Images/graphics when they help explain a point

* Sound effects when appropriate

* TikTok-style pacing

* Music that complements the video without overpowering it

* Visual emphasis on important words or selling points



The goal is **high retention without making the video feel obnoxiously overedited**.



## Most Important Skill



You need to understand **short-form viewer psychology**.



I don't just want someone who knows how to use Premiere Pro or CapCut.



You should be able to look at raw footage and think:



**"What can I change here to stop someone from scrolling and keep them watching?"**



You should understand concepts like:



* Scroll stopping

* Curiosity

* Open loops

* Pattern interrupts

* Watch-time optimization

* Retention

* Pacing

* Product-focused storytelling

* Direct-response style editing



## Requirements



You should have experience editing content for at least one of the following:



* TikTok

* TikTok Shop

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* UGC advertisements

* Direct-response social media ads



**TikTok Shop or UGC editing experience is strongly preferred.**



You should also be:



* Reliable

* Easy to communicate with

* Able to follow an established editing style

* Able to recreate the feel of reference videos I provide

* Able to take direction without needing every individual edit explained

* Able to deliver consistently

* Comfortable receiving large amounts of raw footage

* Detail-oriented

* Able to turn around videos quickly



CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar professional editing software is acceptable.



## What I DON'T Want



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



* Long-form YouTube videos

* Podcasts

* Weddings

* Cinematic videos

* Corporate videos

* Music videos



unless you also have a **strong short-form TikTok/Reels portfolio**.



I'm specifically looking for someone who understands **performance-focused short-form content**.



## Potential Long-Term Opportunity



I'm a high-volume content creator and regularly produce TikTok Shop videos.



I'm looking for someone I can potentially work with **long term**, so there will be consistent work available for the right editor.



As we develop a workflow, I want the editor to learn my style well enough that I can send over **raw footage and video inspiration**, and they can understand exactly how the finished video should look.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your short-form editing portfolio

2. **3–5 of your BEST TikTok/Reels/Shorts edits**

3. Any TikTok Shop or UGC ads you've edited

4. The software you use

5. Your typical turnaround time

6. Your rate per short-form video

7. How many videos you can realistically edit per week



**Important:** Do not send me a portfolio with 50 videos and ask me to choose.



Send me the **3–5 videos that best demonstrate your ability to edit high-retention TikTok content.**



### Application Question



At the bottom of your application, answer:



**"What are the 3 most important things you would do in the first 3 seconds of a TikTok to increase the chances someone keeps watching?"**



Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.

title: Video Editor - AI
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented AI Video Editor to join our team full-time.



Your main responsibility will be turning written creative briefs and reference videos into polished short-form advertisements using AI.



A big part of this role is being able to make AI-generated footage look realistic and natural, not obviously AI-generated.



You should also be comfortable adapting to different creative styles, including:



Realistic human / UGC-style videos

Organic social-media content

Talking-to-camera scenes

Product footage

Animated videos

Fully AI-generated scenes

Reference-based ad recreations



We will train you on our internal workflow and creative process, but you should already be comfortable using Kling and Nano Banana Pro.



Strong experience using ChatGPT to create and improve AI-generation prompts is a major advantage.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Read and understand detailed creative briefs

Study reference videos and closely match their style

Generate realistic images using Nano Banana Pro

Animate images and generate video scenes using Kling

Create realistic human movement, expressions, environments, and interactions

Make AI-generated footage look natural and believable

Adapt between realistic human footage, organic content, and animation styles

Use ChatGPT to help develop and improve prompts

Adjust prompts when results are not good enough

Regenerate scenes until they properly match the brief

Combine clips into finished short-form advertisements

Add captions, text, audio, sound effects, and basic editing where needed

Use CapCut or similar editing software for final assembly

Make revisions based on feedback

Organize files and export videos correctly

Complete assigned work every day and meet deadlines consistently

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should already have:



Hands-on experience with Kling

Hands-on experience with Nano Banana Pro

Experience creating AI images and AI video

A strong understanding of how to make AI footage look realistic

Good visual judgment

Strong attention to detail

Ability to closely follow references

Ability to adapt to different editing and visual styles

Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools for prompt creation

Ability to troubleshoot weak AI generations instead of simply accepting them

Basic video-editing ability in CapCut or similar software

Good organization and file-management skills



Experience creating e-commerce ads, UGC ads, social-media content, direct-response advertising, or short-form videos is highly preferred.



RELIABILITY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



Our creative team needs to produce and submit work every day.



We need someone who:



Shows up consistently

Communicates during working hours

Gives regular updates on their work

Lets the team know immediately if there is a blocker or delay

Does not disappear without communication

Finishes work by the agreed deadlines

Does not need to be constantly chased

Takes responsibility when something goes wrong



If you are going to miss a deadline, we should know before the deadline, not afterward.



One unreliable editor can delay the entire creative team, so consistency and communication matter just as much as editing skill.



ATTITUDE



We want someone who is:



Open to feedback

Easy to work with

Willing to learn

Comfortable making revisions

Not defensive when their work needs changes

Focused on getting the best result rather than protecting their ego



AI video often requires multiple attempts before a scene looks right. You need to be comfortable regenerating and adjusting your work until it reaches the required quality.



THIS ROLE WILL NOT SUIT SOMEONE WHO

Has never used Kling or Nano Banana Pro

Creates AI footage that obviously looks AI-generated

Struggles to create realistic human scenes

Can only work in one visual style

Skims creative briefs

Ignores reference videos

Submits the first AI generation without checking it

Refuses or dislikes revisions

Repeats the same mistakes after receiving feedback

Frequently misses deadlines

Needs constant reminders

Does not provide updates

Disappears during working hours

Gets defensive about feedback

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After your first few months:



You can take a creative brief and understand what needs to be produced

Your AI footage looks realistic and believable

You can adapt between organic human videos, advertisements, and animation

You know how to use prompting to get better generations

You closely match provided references

You catch obvious AI mistakes before submitting work

You deliver work consistently every day

You communicate clearly with the team

You apply feedback without repeating the same mistakes

The team can trust you to complete your work without constantly checking on you

SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

Full-time remote position

Long-term opportunity

Working hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine Time

Salary: $500–$1,000 USD/month, depending on experience and ability

Salary and responsibilities can increase based on performance



We are looking for someone who wants to become a stable, long-term part of the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete the application form below:







You must complete the Google Form to be considered.



Please include examples of your previous AI-generated videos, especially anything involving realistic humans, UGC-style content, animation, or e-commerce advertising.

title: Customer Service, Order Management & Estimating Specialist
description:
Customer Service, Order Management & Estimating Specialist



U.S. Print, Signage, Marketing & Promotional Products Company



We are an established AlphaGraphics print, signage, marketing and promotional products business in Tampa, Florida, and we are looking for a highly responsive, organized and professional remote team member to support our existing Project Management team.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



The role is focused primarily on incoming customer inquiries, quote requests, order coordination and customer communication. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of incoming opportunities and make sure customers receive fast, professional and consistent service.



A major priority for us is speed of response. When a potential customer contacts us for pricing or information, we want them acknowledged almost immediately and then kept informed throughout the estimating process.



Your Responsibilities



Your role would include:



Monitoring incoming customer
s and identifying new quote and estimate requests.

Responding promptly to customers to acknowledge their request and let them know that we are preparing their proposal.

Reviewing customer instructions, specifications and supplied artwork/files.

Identifying missing information and contacting the customer to obtain the details needed to prepare an accurate estimate.

Performing an initial review of artwork for items such as:

- dimensions

- resolution

- bleed

- basic print suitability

Determining, with training, whether work will be produced internally or outsourced to one of our trade/subcontract vendors.

Contacting approved vendors to obtain pricing, turnaround times and other required information.

Preparing estimates using our ERP/estimating system, PrintSmith.

Sending estimates to customers through our CRM system, PrintSpeak.

Following up promptly after sending an estimate to confirm that the customer received it and to answer any initial questions.

Using our CRM to maintain regular estimate follow-up until the opportunity is won, lost or no longer active.

Maintaining accurate customer and opportunity information within our systems.

Communicating with our internal Project Management and Production teams when necessary.

Helping ensure that no incoming customer inquiry or estimate request is overlooked.



Training will be provided on our products, systems and internal processes. Previous experience with PrintSmith or PrintSpeak is not required.



Additional Marketing Responsibilities



There will naturally be periods when incoming customer activity is quieter.



During these periods, we would like this person to assist with outbound digital marketing and sales-support activities.



Depending on your experience, this could include:



Following up with previous customers and prospects.

 outreach.

CRM prospecting.

LinkedIn outreach.

Basic lead research.

Updating customer/prospect information.

Supporting targeted marketing campaigns.

Following up on previously issued estimates.

Potentially making outbound calls to U.S. customers or prospects.



Previous digital marketing or outbound sales experience would therefore be an advantage.



What We Are Looking For



The right person will have:



Excellent written English.

Very good spoken English.

Strong customer-service skills.

The confidence to communicate professionally with U.S. customers.

Exceptional attention to detail.

Strong organizational skills.

The ability to manage several customer requests simultaneously.

A sense of urgency and an understanding that response time matters.

Good numerical ability and comfort working with quotations and pricing.

Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly.

Good judgment and the confidence to ask questions when information is incomplete.

A proactive mindset — we do not want someone who simply waits for instructions.

The ability to work independently while still communicating closely with the rest of the team.

An interest in building a long-term career with one company.



Experience in any of the following would be particularly useful:



Customer service

Order management

Estimating or quotations

Printing or signage

Promotional products

Manufacturing

E-commerce

Project coordination

Sales support

CRM systems

Procurement/vendor sourcing

Digital marketing

Prepress or graphic file checking



A printing background is helpful but not essential. We are more interested in finding someone intelligent, reliable, detail-oriented and willing to learn.



Working Hours



This position supports customers in Florida, USA.



You must therefore be willing and able to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable attendance during these hours is extremely important because one of the primary purposes of this role is to ensure that customers receive very fast responses.



Home Office Requirements



You must have:



A reliable computer suitable for full-time remote work.

A stable high-speed internet connection.

A quiet and professional home working environment.

A headset suitable for customer calls.

A backup internet solution where possible.

A reliable backup plan for local power interruptions.

Long-Term Opportunity



We are not looking for someone for a short-term project.



We are looking for a person who can become an important long-term member of our business.



For someone with the right ability and ambition, the position could eventually develop into broader responsibilities involving:



More advanced estimating

Customer account management

Workflow and process improvement

Online ordering systems

Sales support

Training and supervising additional remote employees

Operations coordination



We value people who identify ways to improve the business rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



When Applying



Please answer all of the following questions in your application:



Would this be your only employment, or do you currently work for other companies or clients?

What are you doing professionally at present?

Why are you interested in this particular position?

How does working U.S. Eastern Time hours fit into your personal schedule?

Which parts of the role described above best match your previous experience?

Have you previously prepared quotations, estimates or pricing for customers? Please explain.

Have you worked in customer service, order management, printing, signage, manufacturing or e-commerce?

Do you have experience with CRM or ERP software? Which systems?

Do you have experience with outbound digital marketing or lead follow-up? Please explain.

Have you previously made inbound or outbound calls with U.S. customers?

Please describe your home office setup, including:

computer specifications

internet speed

backup internet

power backup

dedicated workspace

Please provide your expected hourly or monthly salary.

Please tell us why you believe you would be particularly good at responding quickly and accurately to incoming customer requests.



Please begin your application with the words “FAST RESPONSE” so that we know you have read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone professional, intelligent, dependable and genuinely interested in becoming part of our team for the long term.

title: Lead List Building & Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We run cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a technical, detail-oriented operator to learn and own our list-building operation. This role is a good fit for someone with software-development, automation, or AI-assisted coding experience who is also comfortable doing careful operational work every day.



IMPORTANT ROLE FIT



The main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating our existing list-building process. Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required—we expect to train you on the process.



Development and automation are real parts of the job, but they are not the entire job or the main daily function. You will first learn the workflow, perform it manually, and take responsibility for accurate completed lists. After you understand the operation, you will also use Codex and other tools to fix bugs, improve our software, and automate useful parts of the workflow.



Manual list-building and quality-control work will remain a permanent part of the position even as the tools improve. If you only want to develop software, build systems, or automate processes and do not want regular manual operations work, this role is not a fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn our list-building process and the targeting rules for each client.

- Monitor campaign inventory and replenish lead lists before campaigns run low.

- Turn each client's target audience into accurate, creative search strategies.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lists using AI Ark, our internal List Builder, and approved supporting tools.

- Check company fit, decision-maker fit, recent client history, required fields, and duplicate risk.

- Export, combine, review, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required 90-day checking and personalization steps.

- Review feedback, document completed work, maintain trackers, and communicate real blockers early.

- After learning the workflow, use Codex or similar AI coding tools to diagnose bugs, fix problems, and improve your assigned copy or branch of the List Builder.

- Build useful automations and workflow improvements when they support the operation.

- Test software changes carefully. Do not change the shared production version without approval.

- After training, communicate professionally in relevant client Slack channels.



TOOLS



AI Ark, our internal List Builder,
Bison, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive, spreadsheets, CSV files, and other approved tools.



REQUIREMENTS



- Practical software-development, coding, automation, or AI-assisted development experience. You should have personally built, changed, fixed, or automated real workflows or software.

- Willingness to learn and permanently own the manual list-building and quality-control work, not only the coding and automation work.

- Strong technical problem-solving and critical thinking.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Reliable availability Monday-Friday from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time.

- This is a full-time role. Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or ongoing projects before hiring. They must not interfere with the required schedule or work completed for FlowLead.

- Excellent attention to detail with filters, spreadsheets, CSV files, research, and duplicate checks.

- Honest about errors and never fabricates data.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and power/internet backup.



Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required. We will train you on our process.



PREFERRED



Hands-on experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build or improve real software is especially valuable. Experience with GitHub, Python, JavaScript, APIs, browser automation, or workflow automation is also helpful.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short, specific written application. Briefly:



- Describe one real coding, automation, or AI-assisted development project that you personally built, changed, or fixed.

- Confirm that you understand the main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating the list-building process and that this will remain part of the job.

- Confirm that you can work full-time from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time, and disclose any other current jobs or regular commitments.



Do not send a video with your initial application. Selected applicants will be asked to send a short 2–4 minute video before an interview. The video will cover your technical experience, your understanding of the manual and technical parts of the role, current jobs or other commitments, full-time availability, the $500 monthly compensation, and your earliest start date.



Honest, specific answers are more useful than generic AI-written responses.



HIRING PROCESS



Written application review, short video request for selected applicants, short interview, and a 30–45 minute Apollo search-strategy assignment for selected candidates. The assignment tests how well you learn a manual search process, use judgment, and pay attention to detail—not your previous list-building experience. Candidates do not receive client data or production access during hiring.

title: HR Coordinator (remote)

We want someone who understands the CEO’s vision, believes in where the company is going, and can help communicate that vision clearly to the rest of the team so everyone feels like they are working toward the same goal.

Source and find strong candidates

Organize small online team activities

Help make the company somewhere people are excited to work

We want someone who can naturally create a good environment where people feel connected to the company and to each other.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Very good with people

Organized

Reliable

Organizing activities

Does not genuinely care about how employees are doing

title: Creative strategist
description:

We are looking for a Creative Strategist with strong Direct Response and DTC Ecommerce experience to join our team.



This is not a social media management role.



Your main responsibility will be researching customers, competitors and markets and turning those insights into high-converting Meta ad concepts, marketing angles, hooks and creative briefs.



We sell direct-to-consumer products across international markets and test a high volume of new marketing concepts.



What You Will Do

Conduct deep customer and market research.

Research competitor brands using Meta Ads Library.

Analyse competitor ads, advertorials, landing pages and offers.

Research customer reviews, Reddit discussions, forums, social media comments and other Voice of Customer sources.

Identify customer avatars, desires, pain points, objections and buying motivations.

Identify different levels of customer awareness.

Develop new marketing angles and creative concepts.

Write strong hooks and opening lines for Meta ads.

Develop native
 ad concepts.

Create UGC concepts and scripts.

Create detailed creative briefs for graphic designers and video editors.

Develop concepts for static ads, native ads, UGC and advertorial-style creatives.

Ensure messaging is congruent across the Ad → Advertorial/Landing Page → Product Page.

Analyse creative performance and identify why creatives are winning or losing.

Generate iterations and variations of winning concepts.

Maintain an organised creative testing pipeline.

Present new concepts and testing recommendations regularly.

Skills Required



You should have strong knowledge of:



Direct-response marketing

Meta/Facebook advertising

DTC ecommerce

Customer research

Voice of Customer research

Marketing psychology

Customer avatars

Market awareness levels

Market sophistication

Marketing angles

Hooks

Creative concepts

Advertorials

UGC advertising

Static advertising

Native-style advertising

Creative briefing

Competitor research

Meta Ads Library

Creative performance analysis



Knowledge of principles from marketers and books such as Eugene Schwartz / Breakthrough Advertising is a major advantage.



You Should Be Able to Answer Questions Like:

Who exactly are we targeting?

What does this customer want most?

What pain are they trying to escape?

What have they already tried?

Why didn't those solutions work?

What does the customer already know about their problem?

What is the strongest marketing angle?

What hook will stop them from scrolling?

What creative format should communicate that angle?

Why did one creative outperform another?

What should we test next?

What We Are NOT Looking For

Influencer outreach



This is a performance creative and direct-response marketing role.



Ideal Candidate

Analytical

Creative

Good at identifying patterns

Strong at research

Comfortable working independently

Able to explain WHY a creative should work

Obsessed with understanding customer psychology

Comfortable using data to improve creative decisions

Able to generate multiple angles rather than simply copying competitors



Experience working with supplements, wellness or problem-solving DTC products is highly desirable.



Application Requirement



When applying, please send:

Brands you have previously worked with.

Your experience with Meta Ads Library and competitor research.

Your experience with advertorials and direct-response marketing.

title: Social Media Scheduler & Poster + Simple Video Edits (Entry-Level, Long-Term)
description:
We're FaberX, an
 and SMS marketing agency for e-commerce brands. We put out a high volume of short-form content every day, and we need a reliable person to schedule it, keep it organised, and get it posted consistently.



Read this part first: this is mostly a scheduling and posting role, with some simple editing. It is not a senior editing job. If you're organised, consistent, and happy doing steady daily volume across several accounts, you'll do well here. If you're looking for high-end creative editing work, this isn't the role.



What you'll do day to day:

- Schedule and post content across at least 4 accounts to start: 2 on Instagram, 2 on TikTok, with more platforms likely as we grow.

- Post regularly on each account, ideally around 10 posts per account per day.

- Work in batches: build up a queue of drafts first, then post steadily through the week. Some days are heavier than others.

- Make simple short-form edits in CapCut (cuts, captions, trending formats). Nothing complex.

- Work closely with our small team every day and follow a set style.



Who this is for:

- You're organised and reliable. You don't drop the ball on daily posting.

- You've got basic CapCut skills for quick, simple edits.

- You can follow templates and a set style without much hand-holding.

- You communicate clearly and want steady, long-term work, not one-off projects.



This is an entry-level role and the pay reflects that: $
/month, paid monthly, with room to grow as you prove reliable. Expect around 4-5 hours a day. There's a short paid trial so we can both check the fit before committing.



To apply, answer these four questions in your message. Applications that skip them won't be read:



1. Have you scheduled and posted content across several social accounts before? Which platforms, and how many accounts at once?

2. How do you stay organised managing multiple accounts - what tools, calendars, or drafting systems do you use?

3. Are you comfortable with the $
/month range for this role? Please be honest - it keeps this fair for both of us.

4. Share one or two simple edits you've done. A link is fine.



Thanks for reading this far. We reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.

title: Junior Growth & AI Assistant for Agency | Motivated & Resourceful - US Hours
description:
Hello, we’re looking to hire a full-time Junior Growth & AI Assistant to support our agency with growth research, marketing, AI tools, and day-to-day execution.



We help ecommerce brands grow through paid ads, creative strategy, and better marketing systems.



This is a junior role.



We do not expect you to already be an expert in marketing, growth, or AI.



We’re open to someone who is still raw, but motivated, curious, resourceful, and willing to learn quickly.



You’ll work alongside our team to research growth opportunities, explore AI tools, analyze competitors, improve processes, and help turn ideas into actual execution.



Some days you might research how competitors are advertising.



Other days you might test a new AI tool, help analyze marketing data, research ways to improve a landing page, or figure out how we can make an internal process faster.



We want someone who enjoys figuring things out.



For the right person, this role can grow into a bigger position across growth, marketing, AI, strategy, or operations.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY DOES



You’ll support the team across growth, marketing, research, AI, and execution.



You won’t be expected to know how to do everything immediately.



You’ll receive guidance at the beginning, but we want someone who becomes more independent and resourceful over time.



• Research ecommerce brands, competitors, products, offers, and marketing strategies

• Research ads using Meta/Facebook Ad Library and other platforms

• Look for growth opportunities across ads, websites, offers, creative, and marketing

• Research and test new AI tools that could help the team work better or faster

• Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools for research, analysis, and execution

• Help improve prompts, workflows, and internal processes

• Research ways repetitive tasks could potentially be automated

• Help analyze landing pages, websites, and customer journeys

• Pull marketing data and help create simple reports

• Help identify patterns in ads, creative, competitors, and performance

• Turn research and ideas into organized documents and actionable tasks

• Organize experiments, findings, tools, and resources

• Support designers, strategists, and media buyers when needed

• Help with general marketing and growth tasks across client accounts

• Take feedback, learn quickly, and improve your work



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We don’t expect perfection from day one.



We do expect curiosity, effort, improvement, and attention to detail.



• You complete tasks accurately and on time

• Your research goes deeper than the first result you find

• You can take a problem and investigate possible solutions

• You use AI to improve your work instead of blindly copying its output

• You experiment with new tools and learn how they work

• You ask good questions when you’re stuck

• You learn from feedback and don’t repeat the same mistakes

• You catch small details before submitting work

• You communicate clearly and keep the team updated

• You bring useful ideas and findings back to the team

• You become more independent over time

• You start identifying opportunities without always being asked



WHAT WE CARE MOST ABOUT



Motivation

You want to improve, learn useful skills, and do the work well.



Curiosity

You genuinely enjoy learning how things work and exploring new ideas.



Resourcefulness

When you don’t know something, you research, test, and try to figure it out.



Attention to detail

You notice small mistakes and check your work before submitting it.



Interest in AI

You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you should be genuinely interested in using AI to work better and faster.



Willingness to learn

You take feedback well and improve quickly.



Reliability

When you say something is done, it should actually be done.



Communication

You’re responsive during working hours and speak up early when you’re stuck.



Ownership

You care about the outcome, not just checking a task off a list.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



YOU DO NOT NEED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE.



This is a junior position.



We care much more about how quickly you learn, how resourceful you are, and how much effort you put into your work.



Relevant experience can come from many places.



You may have worked in:



• Marketing

• Ecommerce

• Digital marketing

• Social media

• Content

• Virtual assistance

• Business

• Research

• Data

• Customer service

• Personal projects



TOOLS YOU MAY ALREADY KNOW



You do not need experience with all of these.



Knowing a few and being willing to learn the rest is completely fine.



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Google Sheets

• Notion

• Meta Ads Library

• Meta Ads Manager

• Canva

• Figma

• AI research tools

• Automation tools

• Project management software



BONUS SKILLS



These are helpful, but not required.



• Experience using AI for real work

• Experience with ecommerce brands

• Familiarity with Meta/Facebook ads

• Basic understanding of CRO or landing pages

• Basic reporting or spreadsheet experience

• Experience with automation tools

• Experience researching competitors or markets

• Experience building your own projects



WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



This role is probably not a fit if you:



• Need step-by-step instructions for every task

• Give up quickly when you don’t know how to do something

• Don’t enjoy researching or figuring things out

• Use ChatGPT by copying the first answer without checking it

• Have no interest in AI or new technology

• Are careless with details

• Struggle to stay organized

• Regularly miss deadlines

• Don’t take feedback well

• Only want repetitive VA tasks

• Only want short-term freelance work



SCHEDULE



Full-time

40 hours per week

Monday to Friday

US working hours

Remote



You should be available and responsive during your working hours and comfortable working with an international team.



COMPENSATION



30,000 PHP/month



There is room to grow over time as your skills, reliability, and responsibilities increase.



QUESTIONS (you don't need long answers here)



1. Why are you interested in growth, ecommerce, and AI?

2. What experience do you have with marketing, ecommerce, AI, research, or similar work? It’s okay if your experience is limited.

3. What AI tools do you currently use, and what do you actually use them for?

4. Tell us about something you wanted to do but didn’t know how to do. How did you figure it out?

5. What’s one repetitive task you’ve used AI or another tool to make easier or faster?



IMPORTANT



To apply, start your application message with the word Growth on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please answer the questions above yourself.



We’re looking for your thinking and experiences, not perfect answers written by AI.



TRIAL TASK



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete 1 small paid trial task.



It may involve researching a brand, analyzing marketing, testing an AI tool, or solving a small growth-related problem.



We are not testing whether you already know everything.



We want to see how you research, how you think, how resourceful you are, and how well you follow instructions.



The task won’t be long or time-consuming.



GROWTH PATH



FIRST 30 DAYS



• Learn our agency, clients, systems, and processes

• Understand the basics of ecommerce marketing

• Learn how we research competitors and growth opportunities

• Become familiar with the AI tools we use

• Complete research and recurring tasks accurately

• Learn how the different parts of our marketing team work together



AFTER 60 TO 90 DAYS



• Handle research with less guidance

• Take ownership of recurring growth tasks

• Test and evaluate new AI tools independently

• Help improve internal workflows

• Support marketing analysis and experimentation

• Identify useful ideas and opportunities without always being asked

• Start specializing based on your strengths



LONGER TERM



For someone who keeps learning and performing well, this role could develop into:



Junior Growth & AI Assistant → Growth Specialist → Growth Strategist



Or you may eventually specialize in:



• AI & Automation

• Creative Strategy

• CRO

• Paid Media

• Marketing Operations



The exact path depends on what you’re good at and where you create the most value.



We don’t promise promotions or specific timelines.



Growth comes with increased skill, reliability, ownership, and responsibility.



If you’re motivated, curious, resourceful, interested in AI, and excited to learn how ecommerce brands grow, we’d love to hear from you.



You don’t need to know everything.



You should enjoy figuring things out.

title: Junior Marketing Virtual Assistant | Motivated & Detail-Oriented - US Hours

Hello, we’re looking to hire a full-time Junior Marketing Virtual Assistant to support our agency with the day-to-day tasks that keep our clients’ marketing running smoothly.



We help ecommerce brands grow through paid ads, creative strategy, and better marketing systems.



We do not expect you to already know everything.



We’re open to someone who is still early in their career and may be a little raw. What matters much more to us is that you’re motivated, reliable, detail-oriented, and genuinely willing to learn.

At first, you’ll receive more guidance. As you learn our systems and prove yourself, we’ll expect you to become more independent and take ownership of more tasks.



For the right person, this can be an opportunity to learn ecommerce marketing from inside an agency and eventually grow into a more specialized marketing or creative role.



We’re looking for someone with potential, not someone who already has everything figured out.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY DOES



You’ll support the team across a mix of marketing and admin tasks.



You won’t be expected to own client accounts or make major marketing decisions on day one.



You’ll learn by helping the team, following instructions carefully, asking good questions, and gradually taking on more responsibility.



• Support the team with day-to-day marketing tasks across client accounts

• Research competitors, products, brands, and the Meta/Facebook Ad Library

• Organize creative assets, files, links, and documentation

• Help prepare creative briefs and gather product information

• Assist with pulling performance data and creating simple reports

• Coordinate tasks between designers, strategists, and other team members

• Keep project management tools and trackers up to date

• Upload, schedule, and organize ads and content

• Help with basic edits, formatting, and content organization

• Follow up on tasks and make sure things don’t get forgotten

• Handle general admin and marketing support when needed

• Take feedback from the team and apply it to your next task



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We don’t expect perfection from day one.



We do expect effort, improvement, and attention to detail.



• You complete tasks accurately and on time

• You follow instructions carefully

• Your files, assets, and trackers stay organized

• Your research is thorough and useful

• You ask questions when you’re genuinely stuck instead of guessing

• You learn from feedback and avoid repeating the same mistakes

• You double-check your work before submitting it

• You communicate clearly and keep the team updated

• You become more independent as you learn

• Over time, you start taking ownership of recurring tasks



WHAT WE CARE MOST ABOUT



• Motivation - You genuinely want to learn, improve, and become good at what you do.

• Attention to detail - You notice small things. Names, numbers, offers, spelling, links, and formatting matter.

• Willingness to learn - You don’t need to know everything, but you need to be teachable and willing to figure things out.

• Reliability - If you say you’ll do something, we should be able to trust that it gets done.

• Organization - You keep tasks, files, and information organized and easy to find.

• Resourcefulness - Before immediately asking someone else, you’re willing to research, use Google or AI, and try to find an answer.

• Communication - You respond during working hours and tell us early if you’re stuck or falling behind.

• Ownership - Even as a junior, you care about whether the work is actually done correctly.



• Interest in marketing - You don’t need deep marketing knowledge yet, but you should genuinely want to learn how ecommerce brands grow online.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



Previous agency experience is not required.



You also don’t need years of marketing experience.



We’re happy to consider someone early in their career if they show strong potential.



Relevant experience could include:



• Marketing

• Ecommerce

• Social media

• Content creation

• Virtual assistance

• Admin support

• Data entry

• Customer service

• Digital marketing

• Personal projects or self-taught marketing experience



You may already know some of these tools, or simply be willing to learn them:



• Google Sheets

• Notion

• Canva

• Meta Ads Library

• Meta Ads Manager

• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Asana, ClickUp, or similar project management tools

• Other research, organization, and AI tools



You do not need experience with every tool listed above.



If you’ve never used some of them before, that’s completely fine. We care more about how quickly you can learn.



Bonus if you have:



• Some experience with ecommerce or marketing

• Familiarity with Meta/Facebook ads

• Basic spreadsheet or reporting experience

• Experience organizing content or creative assets

• Experience working remotely with a team



WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



This role is probably not a fit if you:



• Don’t pay attention to details

• Regularly miss deadlines

• Need to be reminded repeatedly about the same tasks

• Don’t like researching or figuring things out

• Get defensive when receiving feedback

• Repeat the same mistakes without improving

• Have no interest in ecommerce or marketing

• Aren’t comfortable learning new tools

• Only want a short-term freelance job

• Want a role where you can do the same simple tasks forever without taking on more responsibility



We are happy to teach someone who doesn’t know something yet.



We are much less concerned with what you know today than how quickly you learn once you’re shown.



SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.



Remote.



You should be able to communicate consistently during working hours and work well with an international team.



COMPENSATION



30,000 PHP/month



There is room to grow over time as your skills, reliability, and responsibilities increase.



QUESTIONS



1. What experience do you have with marketing, ecommerce, admin support, virtual assistance, or similar work? It’s okay if your experience is limited.

2. How do you stay organized when you have several tasks to complete?

3. Tell us about something you taught yourself recently. What did you do when you didn’t know how to do it?

4. What tools are you currently comfortable using? Rate your experience with each from 1 to 10.

5. Tell us about a time you made a mistake at work or school. What did you do after you noticed it?



IMPORTANT



To apply, start your application message with the word Detail on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



TRIAL TASK



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete 1 small paid trial task.



The task will help us understand how you research, organize information, follow instructions, and pay attention to details.



We aren’t expecting expert-level marketing knowledge.



We want to see how you think, how carefully you work, and how willing you are to figure things out.



The task won’t be long or time-consuming.



GROWTH PATH



First 30 days



• Learn our systems, tools, and processes

• Understand how our team works

• Learn the basics of ecommerce marketing

• Complete simple recurring tasks accurately

• Keep files and trackers organized

• Get comfortable asking questions and receiving feedback

• Become reliable with day-to-day support



After 60 to 90 days



• Complete more tasks without step-by-step guidance

• Take ownership of recurring responsibilities

• Handle research and basic reporting more independently

• Understand our clients and their marketing better

• Start supporting more parts of the marketing process

• Identify areas where you’re especially strong



Longer term



For someone who keeps learning and performing well, the path could look like:



Junior Marketing VA → Marketing VA → Marketing Specialist → Creative Strategist / Media Buyer



The exact path depends on your strengths and what you become good at.



We don’t promise promotions or specific timelines. Growth comes with increased skill, reliability, ownership, and responsibility.



If you’re early in your career but motivated, curious, detail-oriented, and hungry to learn, we’d love to hear from you.



You don’t need to come in knowing everything.



You do need to come in ready to learn.

title: Call Center Manager (Remote) Local Lead Gen Agency
description:
Company: Conek

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Mon–Fri, US Eastern business hours with responsibility for West Coast window coverage

Compensation: $1,500 USD/month base + up to $1,000/month performance bonus

Reports to: COO



What Conek does



We run patient acquisition for chiropractic and physical therapy clinics across the US. Ads, lead generation, appointment booking, and show confirmation all under one roof.



Here's what makes us different: our clients pay per patient who actually walks through the door. Not per lead. Not per booking. Per show.



That means our call center isn't a support function. It's the business. If our agents don't book and confirm, we don't get paid.



We're scaling from 15 to 50+ active clients. The call center has to scale with it, and we need someone to own that.



The role



You'll run a distributed team of appointment setters (English and Spanish-speaking) who call warm leads and book them into clinic appointments. You own the number that matters: show rate.



This is not a babysitting job. You will be hiring, training, coaching, correcting, and firing. You'll be listening to calls daily, rebuilding scripts that aren't converting, and holding people to standards most managers are too uncomfortable to enforce.



What you'll own



Team performance. Daily dial cadence across three US timezone windows. Agent-level scorecards. Weekly one-on-ones that actually change behavior.

Quality assurance. Call reviews every single day. You'll catch the agent who's freelancing off-script before the client does.

Client offer accuracy. Every clinic has different pricing, inclusions, X-ray costs, deposit requirements, and doctor availability. You are the last line of defense making sure agents say what the doctor was actually sold — not a generic script.

Deposit collection. Getting money over the phone is what separates a show from a no-show. You'll own execution of our deposit SOP.

Hiring and onboarding. Screening, interviewing, and ramping new agents to productive within two weeks.

Escalations. When a client says "your agents told my patient the wrong price," it comes to you first, and you have a root-cause answer within the hour.



How you'll be measured



Show rate on booked appointments

Booked appointments per agent per shift

Deposit collection rate

Speed-to-lead on new inquiries

Agent ramp time and 90-day retention



Who this is for



You've managed 8+ outbound or appointment-setting agents and have the numbers to prove what you did to their performance.

Your written English is genuinely excellent. Not "good for a non-native speaker" — excellent. You'll be writing scripts, SOPs, and client-facing updates.

You're comfortable being the person who says "that call was bad, here's exactly why, do it again."

You think in systems. When something breaks twice, you build a process instead of fixing it a third time.

You want to build something, not maintain something.



Who this is not for



Anyone who needs a fully-written playbook handed to them before they can start.

Anyone who's uncomfortable with direct feedback in either direction.

Anyone looking for a quiet, stable, predictable role. This is a company in the middle of tripling.



Requirements



3+ years managing outbound calling, appointment setting, or inside sales teams

Hands-on experience with CRM and dialer systems (GoHighLevel experience is a strong plus)

Fluent professional English; conversational Spanish is a significant advantage

Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, backup power/connection

Available for US Eastern hours



How to apply



Do not send a generic CV and cover letter. It will not be read.



Send an
 to [your hiring
] with the subject line "Call Center Manager — [Your Name]" containing:



Your CV.

A short answer (200 words max) to this: One of your agents has the highest booking rate on the team but the lowest show rate. What do you do, and in what order?

A 90-second unlisted video (Loom or YouTube) introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned around an underperforming agent — what you actually did, and what the numbers were before and after.



Applications missing any of the three will be discarded.
