title: Airbnb Interior Designer
description:
Freelance Interior Designer – Airbnb / Serviced Accommodation

About Us



Valstays is a growing UK serviced accommodation management company. We manage Airbnb and short-let properties on behalf of landlords and help take properties from empty or partially furnished homes to fully furnished, guest-ready accommodation.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a talented remote Interior Designer to work with us on a long-term freelance basis.



This is not a full-time position. You will be paid per project completed, with approximately 3–5 projects available on average per month



The Role:



For each new property, you will be responsible for creating a complete furnishing and shopping list using an existing Valstays Google Sheets template.



We will provide you with:



- Photos and videos of the property

- Room measurements and/or floor plans

- A total furnishing budget in GBP

- Our existing Google Sheets template

- Any furniture already inside the property that we're keeping

- A design brief and, where applicable, a feature colour/colour scheme

- Valstays SOPs explaining how we expect our properties to be furnished



Your job is to turn this information into a complete, cohesive furnishing package that is ready for our team to order.



Your Responsibilities:



You will source suitable furniture, furnishings and décor for each room while remaining within the agreed budget.



This can include:



- Beds and mattresses

- Bedside tables

- Sofas

- Dining furniture

- Coffee and side tables

- TVs and TV units

- Desks and chairs

- Mirrors

- Rugs

- Artwork

- Lamps and lighting

- Curtains

- Cushions and throws

- Plants and decorative accessories

- Kitchen items

- Other furnishings required to make the property guest-ready



You will add the product, price, quantity and direct purchasing link to our existing Google Sheets template.



Everything selected throughout the property should complement each other and follow a consistent design style.



Where You'll Source Products



The majority of products will need to be available for delivery within the UK.



You'll primarily source from websites such as:



- Amazon UK

- Wayfair

- Debenhams

- Dunelm

- Ufurnish

and other reputable UK retailers.



You should also be comfortable finding better alternatives from other reliable suppliers when appropriate.



Designing for Airbnb



This is extremely important.



You're not designing someone's personal home. You're designing properties that need to perform commercially as short-term accommodation.



Our properties need to:



- Look fantastic in professional Airbnb photography

- Have a clear and consistent design theme

- Stand out against competing properties

- Feel premium without unnecessarily overspending

- Use durable furniture suitable for frequent guest use

- Be practical and comfortable

- Appeal to a broad range of guests



We want someone who understands how to make a property look considerably more expensive than the actual furnishing budget.



Budget Management



Every project will have a different budget.



You must be confident designing within strict budgets and keeping track of the total cost throughout the project.



For example, you may be given:



"4-bedroom house – £7,500 total budget – grey property with navy feature walls."



You would then design the complete furnishing package around those requirements without exceeding the agreed budget.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who has:



- Professional interior design experience

- A strong eye for colour, proportion and styling

- Excellent furniture and décor sourcing skills

- Experience working with budgets

- Strong attention to detail

- Experience using Google Sheets or Excel

- The ability to interpret room measurements and floor plans

- Good written English

- Reliable communication

- The ability to meet agreed deadlines

- Experience designing residential or hospitality properties



Experience designing Airbnb, serviced accommodation, hotels or other short-term rental properties would be a major advantage.



Ongoing Work



We're not looking for someone for a single project.



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right designer as Valstays continues to grow.



Initially, we'll provide more guidance around our preferred designs and styles. As you become familiar with the Valstays style and our SOPs, we'd like you to become increasingly independent with each project.



Our ideal working relationship is eventually being able to send you a property, floor plan, budget and colour scheme and have you return a complete, well-designed furnishing package ready for our team to order.



How to Apply



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself and your interior design experience.

Your interior design portfolio, ideally including residential, Airbnb, serviced accommodation or hospitality projects.

Examples of any mood boards, furniture schedules or shopping lists you've previously created.

Your proposed price per project.

Your typical turnaround time for a furnishing project.

How many projects you could comfortably complete for us each month.

Details of your experience sourcing furniture and décor online.



Please start your application with the words "VALSTAYS DESIGN" so we know you've read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small paid test project before we begin working together.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Football TikTok Video Editor — Daily 60-75s Story Videos)
description:
We run a growing football (soccer) TikTok brand and need a dedicated editor producing one 60-75 second story video per day in a fast-paced documentary style.



What you'll make: vertical football storytelling videos built from short match clips, player photos on a grid background, stock footage and meme reaction inserts, cut to a pre-recorded voiceover. Reference standard (study this before applying): 
 — your work must match this pacing, caption style and photo treatment.



Scope per video:

1. Source visuals for every narrative beat — short match clips cropped to 9:16, player headshots placed on our grid-background template, and reaction clips on the shock moments — building our shared asset library as you go.

2. Rough-cut against the voiceover at 25-30 hard cuts per minute, no fancy transitions, every fact synced to a matching visual.

3. Caption pass: bold all-caps white text with black outline, player names and transfer fees highlighted in yellow, timed phrase-by-phrase to the voiceover. This is where we judge quality.

4. Consistent colour grade across mixed footage, voiceover-forward audio mix, export 9:16 1080p.



We supply the script, voiceover, beat markers, and a full written SOP.



Requirements: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, strong football knowledge (you must recognise players and find the right clips fast), proven short-form portfolio (2-3 links), one video per working day after the first two weeks, reliable internet.



Paid test task: we send one script + voiceover; you deliver a finished video within 48 hours. Paid regardless of outcome.



Application filter: Watch the reference video before applying. Start your application with the word SCOUT, then tell us in one sentence which club the video says signed Lewandowski for €4.5 million. Applications missing either will not be read.

title: Personal Brand Video Editor — Daily Short Clips + Weekly YouTube Videos from Recorded Sessions
description:
We run a personal brand and need a dedicated editor turning long-form recorded sessions into daily short clips AND weekly YouTube videos.



Short clips (2-3/day): 20-150 second 9:16 clips in a raw, caption-driven style. Reference standard (study before applying): 
 — natural speech kept intact, visible jump cuts, subtle punch-ins on emphasis, word-synced bold captions with keyword highlights, opens instantly on the hook line, ends the moment the point lands.



YouTube videos (2-3/week): 8-20 minute 16:9 edits from the same sessions — one topic per video or several related questions stitched into a themed episode. Same raw style: jump cuts on dead air, occasional punch-ins, on-screen text for key numbers only, simple chapter cards between questions, timestamps in description. Flag 2-3 freeze-frames per video for thumbnails.



Workflow: edit the YouTube video first, then pull the short clips from the same timeline.



Scope:

1. Select the strongest moments — clips open on a question or bold claim and end on a quotable line; episodes open on the best question, no intro.

2. Reframe, jump-cut dead air, punch-ins on emphasis. Do NOT over-edit — the raw feel is the style.

3. Word-synced captions on shorts (bold sans-serif, white with black outline, key words highlighted); light key-phrase text only on longform.

4. Deliver with suggested post captions (shorts) and title options + timestamps (YouTube).



We supply recordings with transcripts and a written style guide.



Requirements: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (CapCut alone not enough for the longform work); portfolio with BOTH short-form and long-form examples (2-3 links each); sustained output of 2-3 clips/day plus 2-3 videos/week after the first two weeks; reliable internet.



Paid test task: one 20-minute recording; deliver your 2 best short clips AND a rough 5-minute longform cut within 72 hours. We judge selection as much as editing. Paid regardless of outcome.



Application filter: Watch the reference clip before applying. Start your application with the word PAYOUT, then tell us in one sentence what account size the speaker says he'd rebuild from. Applications missing either will not be read.

title: Customer Service & Store Operations - eCommerce Australia
description:
Let me guess how your week has gone.



You've applied to fifteen jobs. Maybe thirty. Every one of them wanted "a highly motivated self-starter with excellent communication skills". And every single one has left you refreshing your inbox with no idea whether anyone even opened it.



I'm not going to do that to you. Here's exactly what the job is, and exactly what happens next.



I'm Justin. I run a home decor store here in Australia, and I'm looking for someone to help me run it.



Right now I do everything myself. Sourcing, suppliers, orders, the website  and the phone. Something has to give, and lately it's been the phone. It rings, it goes to voi
, customers wait. Sales get missed.



That's the job. You'd be the person who fixes it.





WHY THIS ONE IS DIFFERENT:



We're at the very start of building a proper team, and you'd be one of the first people in it.



That means something real. The way we handle customers, the systems we use, the standards we set - most of that hasn't been d
 yet. You'd help d
 it. The suggestions you make in month two become the way we do things in month six.



It also means room to grow. As we bring more people on, the person who was here first, who knows how everything works, is the person who steps up. I'm not looking for someone to fill a seat for a year. I'm looking for someone who's still here in five, running things.





WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO:



- Pick up the phone. Answer
s and chat. Chase the enquiries that haven't converted yet.

- Process orders in Shopify and keep suppliers moving

- Update stock levels and catch problems before a customer does

- Keep the website up to date - listings, pricing, images, new products

- Get us posting properly on Instagram, Pinterest and Meta, and help build out
 campaigns





WHAT WE NEED:



- Excellent spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian customers every day, and this is the one we weigh most heavily. 

- Real customer service experience. Real customers, real complaints, real problems solved.

- Clear, warm written English

- A quiet workspace, reliable internet with a backup

- Available Monday to Friday, 6:00am – 2:00pm (Philippine Standard Time)

- Attention to detail 





ABOUT THOSE HOURS:



Because we're Australian, your day runs 6:00am to 2:00pm Manila time. No graveyard shift. No sleeping through the daylight and waking up as everyone else is heading to bed.



You finish in the early afternoon with most of the day still in front of you. Sunshine. The gym. Your kids after school. Dinner with your family, at dinner time. A serious career shouldn't cost you your evenings, and here it doesn't.





NICE TO HAVE (genuinely optional):

Shopify, Canva,
 marketing tools, or experience working in eCommerce. None of these will stop you getting hired. I'd take a brilliant communicator and teach them Shopify over a Shopify expert who can't hold a conversation.





WHAT YOU GET:



- AUD $1,200 per month

- Reviewed every 12 months on performance. Paid leave.

- Actual training - a documented plan and recorded walkthroughs

- A real opportunity to shape how a growing business runs

- Direct access to me. Ask a question, get an answer that day.

- A team that actually enjoys the work. We take the customers seriously and ourselves a lot less so. Expect jokes in the chat, genuine credit when you do something well, and nobody making you feel small for asking a question.

title: Creative Writing, Short Stories for Psychology Game
description:
Hi there, I'm Helen, and I'm the founder of a company called Trove. (www.trove.is).



Trove is a free choose your own adventure game x personality quiz that you play everyday. Over time, it builds up to a stronger and more honest profile of who someone is, beyond what resumes and other profiles can share about a person today. My goal here is a more authentic world... and it starts with play!



I'm looking for a writer to help with crafting short and medium length stories for Trove. 



The stories right now are roughly 70% human-authored with the remainder being 30% AI-assisted writing (because players can do whatever they want, so we use AI to be able to generate adaptable pages. So we'll be using your core stories, characters, plot lines, while using AI to allow for adaptability. 



Your responsibilities will include ideating plotlines (with an eye for understanding also what we can learn from someone based on what they do within your stories), writing the stories in our proprietary authoring system as well as testing/editing them to get them ready for users to play. 



For reference, each short story currently takes me roughly 3-5 hours to ideate, test, write and consider ready for publishing. I'd expect you to be better + faster than me... but I might also want to transition us into writing longer stories. So for now I'd say I expect you to write at least 2-3 playable short stories per week. 



We'll work mainly off of 
 on pre-set times you're available, on a daily basis ideally. I'm happy to figure out a schedule that works for both of us.



In terms of working with me, I'm someone who is reasonably relaxed and not micro-manage-y, but very detail-oriented. Well I guess I can be micro-manage-y, but that only happens if I don't trust you and trust is the hallmark of any good collaboration. I am absolutely a perfectionist though. To learn more about me, you can find some of our other job posts on the official website and that should give you a sense of the kind of company I'm building.



You would be a good fit for this is you already write fiction novels, like reading about your MBTI, playing interactive fiction games, are a part of fandoms, like fanfiction or manga or anime. If you're a good problem solver, detail oriented, and a perfectionist yourself, then you should apply and let me know why you're a good fit.



FOR NEXT STEPS:



1) Please play through this game: 
 and also this one 
 



This should take you less than 10 minutes in total. It will give you a better sense of what each story is and how it plays out. 



2) Write me a note on what you liked about each of the stories and what you didn't like. Please be honest and give your true thoughts, because this will help me calibrate on what your taste is with regards to plot lines and also prose. 



3) Please link me to some of your writing. 



If we move forward, the next step is a paid trial, to just write one story. The pay will be $14 USD for this one trial story. 



Thank you!

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We run cold

IMPORTANT ROLE FIT



The main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating our existing list-building process. Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required—we expect to train you on the process.



Development and automation are real parts of the job, but they are not the entire job or the main daily function. You will first learn the workflow, perform it manually, and take responsibility for accurate completed lists. After you understand the operation, you will also use Codex and other tools to fix bugs, improve our software, and automate useful parts of the workflow.



Manual list-building and quality-control work will remain a permanent part of the position even as the tools improve. If you only want to develop software, build systems, or automate processes and do not want regular manual operations work, this role is not a fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn our list-building process and the targeting rules for each client.

- Monitor campaign inventory and replenish lead lists before campaigns run low.

- Turn each client's target audience into accurate, creative search strategies.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lists using AI Ark, our internal List Builder, and approved supporting tools.

- Export, combine, review, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required 90-day checking and personalization steps.

- Review feedback, document completed work, maintain trackers, and communicate real blockers early.

- After learning the workflow, use Codex or similar AI coding tools to diagnose bugs, fix problems, and improve your assigned copy or branch of the List Builder.

- Build useful automations and workflow improvements when they support the operation.

- Test software changes carefully. Do not change the shared production version without approval.

- After training, communicate professionally in relevant client Slack channels.



TOOLS



AI Ark, our internal List Builder,
Bison, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive, spreadsheets, CSV files, and other approved tools.



REQUIREMENTS



- Practical software-development, coding, automation, or AI-assisted development experience. You should have personally built, changed, fixed, or automated real workflows or software.

- Willingness to learn and permanently own the manual list-building and quality-control work, not only the coding and automation work.

- Strong technical problem-solving and critical thinking.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Reliable availability Monday-Friday from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time.

- This is a full-time role. Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or ongoing projects before hiring. They must not interfere with the required schedule or work completed for FlowLead.

- Excellent attention to detail with filters, spreadsheets, CSV files, research, and duplicate checks.

- Honest about errors and never fabricates data.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and power/internet backup.



Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required. We will train you on our process.



PREFERRED



Hands-on experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build or improve real software is especially valuable. Experience with GitHub, Python, JavaScript, APIs, browser automation, or workflow automation is also helpful.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short, specific written application. Briefly:



- Describe one real coding, automation, or AI-assisted development project that you personally built, changed, or fixed.

- Confirm that you understand the main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating the list-building process and that this will remain part of the job.

- Confirm that you can work full-time from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time, and disclose any other current jobs or regular commitments.



Do not send a video with your initial application. Selected applicants will be asked to send a short 2–4 minute video before an interview. The video will cover your technical experience, your understanding of the manual and technical parts of the role, current jobs or other commitments, full-time availability, the $500 monthly compensation, and your earliest start date.



Honest, specific answers are more useful than generic AI-written responses.



HIRING PROCESS



Written application review, short video request for selected applicants, short interview, and a 30–45 minute Apollo search-strategy assignment for selected candidates. The assignment tests how well you learn a manual search process, use judgment, and pay attention to detail—not your previous list-building experience. Candidates do not receive client data or production access during hiring.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Personal Brand, Instagram Reels (Part-Time)
description:
ABOUT ME



I run an ecommerce business and I post about it on Instagram — building the company, training and the gym, and life in Barcelona. The point of the page is to show people what's actually possible when you commit to something, and to be a real example of it rather than a highlight reel.



My Instagram handle is jaspar_s — look me up before you apply, so you know what you'd be working on.



I started a few months ago and the account is at around 5,000 followers and growing. I film everything myself, every day. The problem is that I no longer have the time to edit it, and half of what I shoot never gets posted. That's the job.



THE WORK



- I drop raw footage into a shared Google Drive folder — clips from my day, gym sessions, and takes of me talking to camera

- You cut them into finished vertical videos for Instagram Reels

- You choose the music and cut to it

- You add captions and on-screen text where it actually helps, not everywhere

- You find the odd extra shot when a video needs one — a scene-setter to open on, a transition

- You drop the finished MP4s back into the same folder

- Around 4-6 videos a week to start, more as we get into a rhythm



To be clear about what this is not: you don't manage my Instagram, you don't post, you don't reply to comments, and you don't need a content strategy. I do all of that. You edit.



THREE KINDS OF VIDEO YOU'LL BE CUTTING



1. Me talking to camera — about business, ecommerce, discipline, training. Long rambling takes that need to become 30-45 tight seconds. Cutting the dead air without it feeling choppy is the skill here.



2. Day in the life — b-roll of the day: working, travelling, walking through the city, coffee, gym, whatever I shot. Little or no dialogue. This one lives or dies on pacing and music.



3. Training and gym — rhythm and energy, music-led.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU



- Edit short-form vertical content regularly, and your portfolio shows it

- Have genuine taste in music and know how to cut on the beat — this is the single thing I care most about

- Can take a four-minute talking take and make it 40 seconds that hold attention

- Bring your own ideas. I'll give you footage and a direction, not a shot list. If you see a better way to build the video, I want you to take it.

- Can hold a consistent look week after week, so the page has a style instead of looking like ten different editors

- Turn a video around in 24-48 hours

- Write clear, natural English and are easy to reach

- Are reliable. Consistency beats brilliance here — I'd rather have good videos every week than great ones sometimes.



NICE TO HAVE



- You actually watch this kind of content — fitness, business, lifestyle creators — and have opinions about who's good

- Comfortable in CapCut, Premiere Pro or After Effects

- You can do a clean auto-caption pass and style it well

- You know where to find good stock b-roll when a video needs a shot I didn't film

- Some sense of colour grading — I want the videos to feel warm and cinematic, not flat phone footage



COMPENSATION



Competitive, based on experience — we'll discuss it on the call. Part-time to start, and I'd rather build this into something long-term with one person than rotate through freelancers.



TO APPLY — READ THIS PART CAREFULLY



There's a short test, and I only read applications that include it. I know that's real work. I'd rather see one video you cut than a list of software you own.



Step 1 — Put the word BARCELONA at the very top of your application, so I know you read this.



Step 2 — Get the footage. OnlineJobs removes links from job posts, so you'll have to type this one in yourself. Go to drive dot google dot com and add this to the end of the address:



/drive/folders/1XBR6FxSO5MasxMwHWYHkXYm7kibUVOuG



Inside you'll find the raw clips and a short brief. Read the brief first — it has the two videos I'm using as inspiration.



Step 3 — Cut one video. One finished Instagram Reel from that footage. Vertical, 1080 x 1920, between 20 and 45 seconds, with music.



You don't have to use every clip — use what works. You're also welcome to add an outside shot if the video needs one, like something to open on. Beyond that the creative call is yours, and that's the point of the test: I want to see your ideas, not just your software skills.



Step 4 — Send me:



- The finished video as an MP4

- Two or three sentences on why you cut it that way: the track you chose and why, what you left out, and which shots (if any) aren't from my footage

- A link to your portfolio or recent short-form work

- How long it took you



Send it as one link — Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer.



Applications without the video are not read. If something in the brief is unclear, ask me before you start — a question costs nothing.

This is a **full-time, long-term position**. We do not hire editors to cycle through. We hire people we want to grow with, and we protect our best people.

- Hook variations and creative iterations

- Testimonial, review-style, and listicle ads

Direct-Response Editing

You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and what makes them buy. You can turn a script and a brief into a complete, conversion-focused ad. You know how to build a hook, carry tension through the video, and close with a call to action that actually converts.



UGC Editing

You can take raw creator footage and make it feel effortless. You know when to cut, when to leave imperfections in, and how to improve weak delivery without making the creator sound edited.



AI Video Production

You can use AI tools to generate or enhance spokesperson footage, voice-overs, and B-roll. You know how to catch the glitches, correct unnatural pacing, and produce an end result that does not feel artificial.



Motion Graphics and Sound Design

You can animate text, benefits, reviews, and offers in ways that aid clarity. You understand audio balancing, music selection, and how sound design affects retention.



Organization and Communication

You manage your own workload. You know what is due and when. You communicate blockers before they become problems. You submit clean, organized project files every time.



  Required Experience



- Professional video editing experience (senior level)

- Direct experience creating
 ad creative for 
 
 brands

Our top editors earn **$5,000–$7,000 per month** when base and performance bonuses are combined. That ceiling is real. We have editors hitting it.

.com]**

title: Google Ads Specialist – B2B SaaS Lead Generation (Saudi Arabia)
description:
We are a Saudi software company looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to launch and optimize a lead-generation campaign for InjazatHR, our cloud-based HR management platform for companies in Saudi Arabia.



Website: 



The Assignment



Our objective is not simply to generate traffic, impressions, or clicks. We want to generate qualified leads from Saudi companies that are actively looking for an HR management system.



We currently have a Google Ads promotional offer requiring us to spend approximately SAR 4,000 within 60 days, after which we may receive an additional advertising credit subject to Google's terms.



We therefore want someone who can make effective use of a relatively small initial advertising budget.



The selected specialist will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our website and recommending improvements to increase conversions.

* Researching the Saudi Arabian market and our Google Ads competitors.

* Conducting detailed keyword research in Arabic and English.

* Identifying high-intent keywords used by companies searching for HR software.

* Creating and structuring Google Search campaigns.

* Writing and testing effective ad copy.

* Setting up appropriate keyword match types and negative keywords.

* Setting up Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking, where required.

* Tracking demo requests, enquiries and other meaningful conversions.

* Monitoring search terms and eliminating irrelevant traffic.

* Optimizing bids, keywords, advertisements and campaigns throughout the advertising period.

* Providing clear weekly performance reports and recommendations.



About InjazatHR



InjazatHR is a Saudi cloud-based HR management platform with Arabic and English web and mobile applications.



The platform includes features such as:



* Employee and Manager Self-Service

* Attendance and Time Management

* Mobile Attendance

* Geofencing and Wi-Fi validation

* Leave and Employee Request Workflows

* Employee Documents and Expiry Alerts

* Payroll-related HR processes

* Employee Services

* Dashboards and Analytics

* Arabic and English interfaces

* Local Saudi support



Our target customers are primarily companies in Saudi Arabia, rather than individual consumers.



Who We Are Looking For



You should have proven experience with:



* Google Ads / PPC

* **Google Search Ads**

* B2B lead generation

* SaaS or business software campaigns, preferably

* Keyword and search-intent research

* Conversion tracking

* GA4 and Google Tag Manager

* Landing-page conversion optimization

* Negative keyword management

* Campaign optimization based on cost per qualified lead, rather than clicks alone



Experience advertising in Saudi Arabia or other GCC markets would be a significant advantage.



Arabic-language advertising experience is also an advantage, but not essential if you are highly experienced technically. We can assist with reviewing Arabic terminology and advertising copy.



Important



We are not looking for a general social-media manager, SEO specialist, graphic designer or virtual assistant.



We specifically want someone with strong, hands-on Google Ads lead-generation experience.



This will initially be a project/part-time assignment. If the campaign performs well, there is potential for an ongoing relationship as we increase our advertising activities.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Briefly describe your Google Ads experience.

2. Give examples of B2B, SaaS or software campaigns you have managed.

3. What monthly advertising budgets have you managed?

4. Have you managed campaigns targeting Saudi Arabia or the GCC?

5. What is your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking?

6. How do you measure whether a B2B Google Ads campaign is successful?

7. Please provide examples or screenshots of Google Ads results you have achieved, with confidential client information removed.

8. State your hourly rate and estimated number of hours you believe would be required for the initial setup and first month of management.



Short Practical Assessment



Please visit 
 before applying.



In a few paragraphs, explain how you would approach the following:



We have SAR 4,000 to spend on Google Ads over approximately 60 days. We want qualified leads and demo requests from companies in Saudi Arabia looking for an HR management system. How would you structure the campaign, what would you track, and what would you focus on during the first 30 days?



Please do not send a generic or AI-generated proposal. We are particularly interested in your analysis of our specific product, market and advertising objective.

title: Short-Form Gaming Content Creator / Video Editor – Plix.gg
description:
Plix.gg is a browser games portal with 74,000+ games and 180K+ monthly visitors. We're hiring one person to own our short-form video output end to end: find the games, record them, come up with the concepts/hooks, edit the videos, and post them.



This is NOT an editing-only role and NOT a beginner position. We do not send you footage or scripts. You need to understand gaming content and know what a polished TikTok/Reel/Short should look and sound like.



Quality references:













WHAT YOU DO:

* Dig through our catalogue and find games actually worth making videos about

* Record gameplay yourself in high quality at a stable 60 FPS

* Write your own hooks and concepts — you are the ideas person

* Edit 10–40 second videos with strong pacing, clean fonts/captions, music, zooms, transitions, sound design, meme SFX, etc.

* Use AI voiceovers when they improve the video

* Test alternative opening hooks and tell us what performed better



Anything that works goes: gameplay, memes, challenges, reactions, listicles, POV, storytelling, etc. We don't have one template and we don't want one.



If you can create good 3D/AI animations as part of your concepts, that's also completely fine.



OUTPUT:

7-10 finished videos per week.

Each one gets posted to TikTok, Reels and Shorts (You do not need to upload it)

We measure retention and views, not file count. Tell us when a concept is weak instead of shipping something bad just to hit a number.



HOURS:

We don't care when you work. No fixed schedule, no timezone overlap and no clocking in.

Everything can be scheduled in advance, so nobody needs to be awake at upload time.



VOICE & AI:

You do not need to appear on camera or use your own voice, although you're welcome to.

* AI voiceovers: allowed and encouraged

* AI captions/script assistance: fine

* Good AI/3D animation: fine

* Low-effort AI-generated B-roll, generic slideshows or the same template repeated across dozens of videos: not allowed



SETUP YOU NEED:

* A PC capable of running browser games smoothly while recording stable 60 FPS

* 2K monitor minimum, 4K preferred, so gameplay can be captured from a high-quality source

* CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar — we don't care which

* Stable internet connection

* You deliver project files alongside exports



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

* Not a beginner — you already know how to make polished short-form content

* Strong short-form editing, with work to show

* You understand hooks and first-3-second retention

* Good sense for fonts, captions, music, SFX, meme sounds, pacing and visual quality

* You genuinely enjoy gaming and can recognize when a game has good content potential

* Comfortable using AI voiceovers and modern editing/AI tools

* Able to work independently — we give feedback weekly, not hourly



PAY:

$900/month (approx. 55,000 PHP), paid monthly via Wise.



Send:



1. 1-4 short-form videos you edited. Say exactly what you did on each, did you record it, come up with the concept, write it, or just edit it?



2. Your editing software.



3. THREE video ideas for Plix.gg. Each must name a specific game with its plix.gg URL, plus the exact opening line/hook you would use. This is the part we judge most.



4. Explain how you keep someone watching past the first 3 seconds. Be specific: how you choose clips, cut to music, use transitions, zooms, sound effects and text timing. Don't give us buzzwords — tell us what you actually do.



5. Your PC specs, monitor resolution and internet speed.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial video: 1,000 PHP, paid whether or not we hire you. We run several trials at the same time.

title: DIGITAL PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
Great campaigns need more than good ideas. They need someone who can keep the work moving when there are multiple clients, competing deadlines, missing inputs, and several people involved in every deliverable.



Leads Global is looking for a Digital Project Coordinator who wants to become the person a marketing team can rely on when work gets busy. You will work at the centre of client delivery, helping turn ideas into organised, on-time execution across copy, creative, paid media, landing pages, and campaign implementation.



This is a strong career opportunity for someone with hands-on social media or digital marketing experience who is ready to move into project coordination. You will not be expected to be a senior manager on day one. You will be given real responsibility, clear standards, and the opportunity to grow into a capable project-management professional.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will manage the daily flow of client work in Basecamp. You will make sure every task has a clear owner, due date, next action, and enough context for the assigned person to begin without guessing.



You will coordinate across copywriters, designers, media buyers, developers, and contractors. You will follow up before deadlines become a problem, identify what is missing, and help remove obstacles so the team can deliver quality work on time.



When an issue needs a decision, you will raise it early and clearly. When a client needs an update, you will help prepare communication that is calm, accurate, and useful. Your work will make it easier for everyone else to focus on doing excellent work.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



You have practical experience in social media, digital marketing, content coordination, paid media support, or a creative/digital agency. You understand the basics of how marketing campaigns are built and why small details can make the difference between a smooth launch and a stressful one.



You are the person who notices when something does not add up. You keep track of details, follow through on what you say you will do, and prefer to solve a problem while it is still small. You can manage several moving parts without losing the larger picture.



You communicate clearly in written English. You are comfortable asking precise questions, following up professionally, and giving others the information they need to do their best work. You are open to feedback, eager to learn, and serious about building a long-term career in digital project coordination.



Experience with Basecamp is a plus. Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Trello, Notion, or similar tools is also useful. Familiarity with Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media content, campaign assets, landing pages, or funnel work will be an advantage.



We use AI tools to improve speed and quality across the business. We value people who can use AI intelligently while maintaining good judgement, checking details, and taking responsibility for the final outcome.



WHY LEADS GLOBAL



You will be part of a team that cares about doing thoughtful work well. We value integrity, clear communication, continuous improvement, and measurable marketing results. You will receive practical exposure to real client delivery and a clear pathway to grow your project-management capability as you prove yourself.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form: 



Qualified applicants will receive a practical assessment. It is designed to show how you approach project coordination, competing deadlines, incomplete information, and client communication.

title: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES
description:
ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES



Full-Time | 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time | $8–$10/hour + $30–$50 Per Qualified Meeting Held



This is not an entry-level cold-calling job.



We're a U.S.-based IT asset disposition, e-waste recycling, and data destruction company looking for one genuinely excellent B2B lead generator to join our Philippine-based team.



If you're confident on the phone, communicate exceptionally well with U.S. professionals, think on your feet, and consistently turn cold prospects into real opportunities, we want to hear from you.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes 100 calls and reads a script.



We want someone who builds pipeline — including with prospects who may not need us today but will six months from now.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Call U.S. businesses and speak with IT managers, office managers, facilities managers, owners, and other decision-makers.



You'll identify IT recycling, data destruction, and equipment disposition opportunities; qualify and book meetings for our sales team; follow up by phone and
; re-engage older leads; and maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED



-2+ years of successful B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

-Substantial experience calling U.S. businesses

-Exceptionally clear, natural spoken English — U.S. prospects should understand you easily and without effort

-Strong objection-handling and conversational skills

-Persistence without being pushy

-Strong organization and follow-up habits

-Ability to work independently and take ownership of results



IT services, MSP, SaaS, telecom, technology, or recycling experience is a plus.



Zoho and Dialpad experience are helpful but not required. We'll teach the software to the right salesperson.



COMPENSATION



$8–$10/hour base, based on experience



PLUS a tiered monthly bonus for every qualified meeting that is actually held:



-1–9 meetings: $30 each

-10–14 meetings: $40 each

-15+ meetings: $50 each



Crossing a tier raises ALL qualified meetings held that month to the higher rate.



Examples:



-9 meetings = $270

-10 meetings = $400

-15 meetings = $750



There is no cap.



Strong performers can realistically earn $1,800–$2,400+ per month.



A qualified meeting means you reached the right business contact, identified a legitimate current or foreseeable need, and the prospect genuinely agreed to meet with our sales team.



You do not need to establish budget or timeline — that's our sales team's job.



No bonus for calendar stuffing, unqualified meetings, or no-shows.



Once a meeting is legitimately qualified and held, it's paid.



FORMER EMPLOYER REFERENCE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Before any offer is made, we must personally speak with at least one former supervisor, manager, or business owner who directly managed your B2B calling or appointment-setting work.



A coworker, personal reference, or HR-only employment verification will not substitute.



We will only contact the reference once you are a finalist.



If you cannot provide this reference, please do not apply.



HOW TO APPLY



Use exactly 12 Apply Points. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please answer:



-How many years of B2B calling experience do you have, including experience calling U.S. businesses?

-What industries have you called?

-In your most recent role, approximately how many qualified meetings did you book each month, and how many actually held?

-What CRM and calling platforms have you used?

-What hourly rate are you seeking?



REQUIRED: 60–90 SECOND RECORDING



Include a Loom, Vocaroo, or similar voice/video recording created specifically for this application. No generic introduction you've sent to multiple employers.



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared answer.



Tell us:



-Your name

-Your recent B2B calling experience

-One specific cold call from the last few months that didn't go as expected and what you did



Do not perform a scripted sales pitch.



If we interview you, you'll be given live cold-call situations and objections you have not seen in advance.



Subject: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR – [Your Name]



We're hiring one person.



If you're genuinely excellent at generating B2B opportunities and want your compensation tied directly to performance, we want to hear from you.

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist for Scaling DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FIRST: To apply, start your message with the word ANGLE. Applications without it get deleted unread. We do this to find people who actually pay attention to detail.



## About Us



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands (beauty). We move fast, test constantly, and live and die by our ad creative. We're not a corporate agency. You'll work directly with the founder, get quick feedback, and see your concepts go live in real campaigns within days.



## The Role



You'll own the front of the funnel: research → angles → hooks → briefs → iteration. You d
 what we make and why, not just how it's cut. This is performance strategy, not "brand vibes." You're measured on ROAS and CPA, not on how clever a concept sounds in a meeting. You'll turn customer research and competitor teardowns into a steady pipeline of testable ad concepts that actually scale.



## What You'll Do



- Research markets, customers, reviews, and competitors to find the angle

- Write hooks, scripts, and shot-by-shot briefs for editors and UGC creators

- Own the creative testing roadmap — what we test next, and why

- Read the data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and d
 what to double down on or kill

- Turn winners into fresh angles, formats, and variations for testing (not lazy re-cuts)

- Direct editors and creators, and QC that the output matches the concept

- Keep a swipe and insight library so we're never starting from zero



## Must-Haves (track record required)



- 2+ years as a creative strategist for DTC/e-commerce (health/wellness or beauty strongly preferred) with Trackrecord

- You can point to specific winning ads/angles YOU conceived — and the numbers they hit

- Deep direct-response instincts: awareness levels, angles, mechanisms, hooks, offers

- You understand the full funnel — ad → advertorial/VSL/landing page → conversion

- Comfortable reading an ad account and forming a POV, not waiting to be told

- Strong written English — briefs a creator or editor can execute without 10 follow-ups

- High volume and fast iteration don't scare you



## Nice-to-Have



- Hands-on with AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, Topaz, etc.)

- Can rough-cut or storyboard your own concepts

- Worked directly with media buyers on scaling accounts

- Familiar with advertorial and VSL structures



## Hours & Growth



Start at 20 hrs/week. If your angles win and you're reliable, this grows into more hours, a higher rate, and more ownership. We keep good people long-term.



## How to Apply (follow exactly — this is the test)



1. Start your message with ANGLE

2. Link a portfolio or case docs of ads/angles you concepted — concepts + results, not pretty edits you didn't strategize

3. In 3–4 sentences: pick your best-performing angle, the research/insight behind it, why the hook worked, and the result (ROAS / CPA / spend scaled — real numbers)

4. Tell us your process for finding a brand-new angle from scratch

5. List the tools you use (research, briefing, AI, analytics)

6. Confirm your weekly availability and timezone

7. how long youre in Creative Strategy already and track record



Applications that skip any step, hide the numbers, or lead with a generic "I'm hardworking and passionate" intro will not be reviewed.

================================================

ABOUT US

================================================



At OpenPath Finance, we help business owners, Bitcoiners, and freedom-minded entrepreneurs take control of their finances, reduce their tax burden, and build lasting wealth.



We're not here just to file returns. We work closely with clients year-round to strategically plan their tax and financial operations and ensure those plans are reflected in their books and filings. We care about the details because they drive real results.

.

================================================

The goal is simple: by the time a return reaches the tax advisor for final sign-off, it has been prepared carefully and reviewed thoroughly. His role is a quick final check, not a detailed review. That standard is on you and your teammate to uphold together.



This is a technical, detail-oriented role with real accountability. You'll work independently, manage your own queue, and communicate clearly when something needs escalation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

================================================

REQUIREMENTS

================================================

- Works independently, meets deadlines, and follows through without being chased

- Available during U.S. business hours, with morning Central Time availability required for weekly team meetings and working sessions with their team pod



================================================

PREFERRED

================================================



- Experience reviewing others' tax work, not just preparing

- Familiarity with TaxDome or similar tax workflow platforms

- Knowledge of Bitcoin, Bitcoin mining, and related tax and accounting considerations



================================================

GROWTH PATH

================================================



This starts as a seasonal, part-time engagement. For the right person, there is a clear path to increased hours, year-round work, and a more senior role within the firm as we grow. We invest in people who take ownership and grow with us.



================================================

2. A short note -- no more than 2 paragraphs -- on why this role interests you and what kind of tax work you've handled most

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About Us



We help wedding filmmakers create better wedding films and grow the business side of their business. We’re a lean, 7‑figure online coaching company. You’ll work directly with our ads content team.





Role Overview

Your mission is to turn raw talking‑head content, screen recordings, and behind‑the‑scenes clips into short‑form, direct‑response ads for
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok that drive leads and sales.



You’ll take hooks, scripts, and raw footage, and deliver ad‑ready edits on time every week without needing to be chased.



This is not a cinematic / vlog editor role. It’s a performance ad editor role: fast hooks, clear promises, clean captions, simple b‑roll.







Responsibilities

- Edit short‑form vertical ads (15–60 seconds) for Reels, TikToks, Shorts, and in‑feed placements.



- Turn raw footage + hook ideas into 3–4 new ad concepts per week, plus 2–3 variants per concept (different hooks, captions, CTAs).



- Add captions, on‑screen text, simple transitions, b‑roll, and sound effects following our style guide.



- Cut multiple hook versions from the same base video to test different openings.



- Export in correct formats and aspect ratios, name files correctly, and organize them in our content folders.



- Do a clean quality check before submitting (spelling, audio, framing).



- Hit agreed weekly output and communicate early if anything will be late. Turn revisions around within 24 hours.







Requirements

Strong portfolio of short‑form ads or UGC‑style edits (not just travel vlogs / montages).



Excellent editing skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar.



Great eye for:

- Hooks and thumb‑stops in the first 3 seconds

- Pacing for 15–60s ads

- Clean, simple, modern style





Basic understanding of what makes an ad sell (clear promise, proof, CTA).



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Reliable internet for downloading / uploading video.

- Able to handle at least 3–4 new concepts and 20–30 finished ads per week.

- Able to start ASAP.





Nice to Have (not required)

- Experience with: direct‑response ads, online courses/coaching, Meta/TikTok ad creatives, motion graphics, AI tools, thumbnail design, working inside a content/ad pipeline.





Do NOT apply if:

- You are an agency or plan to subcontract work to someone else.

- You can’t reliably commit to weekly output and deadlines.

- You dislike following a style guide, checklists, or a set process.

- You are looking for a one‑time gig (this is ongoing, long‑term work).





Compensation & Growth

- This is a full‑time, ongoing role.

- Starting: $600-$1,200 USD per month (depending on experience and location) for:

- 3–4 new ad concepts per week

- 12–16 finished ads per week

- First 90 days are a ramp period at the starting rate.

- After 90 days, if you’re consistently hitting volume + quality, we’ll review and can increase to $800-$1,200+/month and/or give more responsibility.

- Small performance bonuses possible for new winning creatives that beat our current best ads.





How to Apply (follow these steps exactly)

- Join the Skool group here: 
 

If you already joined, please turn on your notifications. Our team will reach out to you there if it’s a fit.





- Subject line: change your
 subject to:

“I want to edit ads for [Founder’s Name]”



- Portfolio: reply with:

3–5 links to short‑form ads or UGC‑style edits you’ve done (Reels/TikTok/Shorts). Do not share any long form videos. 



- Briefly state which tool you used (Premiere, CapCut, etc.).



- Applications that do not follow these steps will not be considered.



If considered:

- $10 paid test project (2–3 hours).

- If hired, 2‑week paid trial at the agreed monthly rate.

- If we’re both happy, this becomes a long‑term role with the 90‑day ramp and then a raise based on performance.

title: Find Viral Tiktok & Youtube Stories - Easy Flexible Side Gig
description:

This is a simple, flexible side job. You can work at any time. No previous experience is needed. Students and beginners are welcome.

Your job is:



1. Find an interesting video or account.

2. Find the original post and real date.

3. Explain the story in three short parts: what started, what happened next, and how it ended.

4. Paste the links to me



Old videos are welcome. A story from
can still be perfect.



A good idea must have:



- A video that makes people stop scrolling.

- Something interesting happens after the first clip.

- An ending, reveal, result or consequence.

- A story that anyone can understand.



Please do not send football highlights, politics, celebrity gossip, AI videos or random funny clips with no story.



Here are three examples of the type of story I want:



1. Bread Guy - a simple internet joke later became part of his wedding:

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3AT9FtIU3Mk



2. Burger King's advertisement went wrong because the internet changed the ending:

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/XS0juMABVZs



3. A man spent months turning his running routes into an animation:

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Vl2Uh9p7yRY



Please watch all three examples before applying. Do not send these same stories.



Pay is $4 for each qualified story idea, with a maximum of seven paid ideas per week. If all seven are good and delivered on time, you receive an extra $5 bonus. Payment is sent weekly via Wise.



Chosen applicants will receive a paid $10 test.



HOW TO APPLY:



Do not send a CV or a long cover letter. Reply using exactly four numbered lines:



1. Write PURPLE BREAD.

2. What did Bread Guy use instead of a wedding cake?

3. Which of the three example stories is best, and why?

4. Link one viral clip or internet story you found yourself. Send the original/raw post from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit or X, not a commentary video. In one sentence, explain what makes it an interesting story. Older clips are welcome.



Keep your complete application under 250 words, and WITHOUT the use of AI for the whole application. Applications that ignore these instructions will not be considered.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.
