title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller (List Builder)
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Application – Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

description:
Remote Fleet Operations Manager — U.S. Car Rental Company



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based private car rental company.



We currently own 17 vehicles and are actively expanding, with a goal of reaching 50 vehicles by December 2026.



We are looking for a highly capable Fleet Operations Manager who can help the owner organize, systemize, and eventually manage the day-to-day operation of the company.



This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We want someone who thinks like an operator, solves problems independently, builds systems, and wants to grow into a leadership position.



YOUR ROLE



You will work directly with the owner initially and progressively take responsibility for daily fleet operations.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing customer inquiries and following up with rental leads

*
 Marketplace/Messenger customer communication

* Screening and qualifying prospective renters

* Coordinating reservations and vehicle availability

* Managing rental agreements and customer documentation

* Tracking rental payments, security deposits, extensions, and overdue balances

* Managing late renters and overdue vehicles according to company procedures

* Coordinating vehicle pickups and returns

* Tracking every vehicle’s operational status

* Coordinating mechanics, repair shops, towing, cleaning, and other vendors

* Tracking preventative maintenance, mileage, registration, and insurance status

* Tracking tolls, tickets, parking violations, and renter responsibility

* Managing accident/damage documentation and assisting with claims administration

* Maintaining accurate customer and vehicle records

* Maintaining the company’s fleet dashboard and CRM

* Creating and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Producing a concise daily operations report for the owner

* Eventually helping hire, train, and supervise additional support staff



WHO WE WANT



Direct experience with Turo, private car rentals, vehicle fleets, dealerships, automotive operations, or rideshare rental fleets is strongly preferred.



You should have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills

* Strong customer-service skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience with Google Sheets

* Experience with CRM or operations-management software

* Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time

* Ability to manage multiple problems simultaneously

* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills

* Ability to create clear processes and SOPs

* Confidence communicating with customers, mechanics, vendors, and team members



Most importantly:



We want someone who takes ownership.



When something goes wrong, your first response should be:



“How do I solve this?”



—not—



“Let me ask the owner what to do.”



There will always be situations that require escalation, but the goal is to build an operation that does not depend on the owner handling every routine decision.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As the fleet grows, the successful candidate can grow into:



Head of Fleet Operations



You may eventually supervise customer-service VAs, administrative staff, and local fleet personnel.



We are building the management team now while the company is growing.



COMPENSATION



$5–$7 USD/hour to start, depending on experience and ability.



Full-time opportunity.



Performance bonuses and compensation growth will be available as responsibilities and fleet size increase.



Exceptional candidates with substantial fleet-management experience may be considered above this range.



?



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send only a generic résumé or copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words:



“FLEET 50”



Then answer ALL of the following questions.



1. CAR RENTAL EXPERIENCE



Have you personally worked for:



* Turo host

* Private car-rental company

* Rideshare/gig-driver rental fleet

* Dealership

* Fleet-management company

* Automotive company



If yes, explain:



How many vehicles were in the fleet?



What exactly were YOU responsible for?



Be specific.



2. SOFTWARE & SYSTEMS



Tell us which of the following you have personally used:



* Turo

*
 Marketplace

*
 Messenger

* Google Sheets

* CRM systems

* Fleet-management software

* GPS tracking systems

* Payment-processing systems

* Project-management software

* Automation software



Tell us what you actually did with each system.



3. OPERATIONS TEST



Imagine you are responsible for a 20-car rental fleet.



It is Friday at 7:30 PM.



Vehicle #8: Supposed to return at 6:00 PM. The renter isn’t responding.



Problem: Another customer is scheduled to receive Vehicle #8 Saturday at 9:00 AM.



At the same time:



Vehicle #12: The renter reports that a warning light just appeared.



And:



Vehicle #4: The renter wants to extend another seven days but has unpaid toll charges.



The owner is unavailable.



Explain exactly what you would do, in order.



We care more about your reasoning than having one “perfect” answer.



4. LATE PAYMENT TEST



A renter is two days late paying.



They keep saying:



“I’ll have the money tomorrow.”



The renter still has the vehicle and continues driving it.



Explain how you would manage the situation from beginning to resolution.



5. BUILDING SYSTEMS



You join a growing rental company where many procedures currently exist only in the owner’s head.



What are the first five systems/processes you would build or document?



Explain why you chose them.



6. SOP TEST



Write a short Standard Operating Procedure for:



Vehicle Return ? Vehicle Inspection ? Preparing Vehicle for the Next Renter



Keep it simple but operational.



7. VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Please provide a 2–3 minute video introduction explaining:



* Who you are

* Your relevant experience

* Why you believe you can help operate this company

* The largest fleet you’ve worked with

* One thing you would immediately improve when joining a rapidly growing rental fleet



IMPORTANT



We’re not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We’re looking for someone who can eventually run the operation, build systems, solve problems, manage people, and help us scale from a small fleet into a professionally managed rental company.



If you’re looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and compensation can grow significantly with the company, we’d like to hear from you.



Remember to start your application with: FLEET 50

title: Busy SEO Content Solopreneur Seeks a Consistent Content Operator Who Communicates
description:
I run SEO content for 4 clients. Every month, 28 pages have to get written, edited, illustrated, published, and logged on time, every time, without me chasing anyone.



I need one person to own that entire loop. This is not a "get 28 pages live on schedule with zero drama" job.



The monthly load

Client A — 4 pages, B2B service

Client B — 2 pages, B2C service for kids

Client C — 2 pages, B2B/B2C product

Client D — 20 pages, real estate



What each post actually involves

1. Take the brief. I give you the topic, keyword, and angle. The calendar is locked before the month starts.

2. Run it through the prompt library to generate a draft.

3. Edit that draft into something a real person would want to read. This is the part I care about most.

4. Choose and size 4-12 images per page in Canva, to brand spec.

5. Publish in the client's CMS: meta title, meta description, H1, internal links, alt text, page slug, post category, featured image, in-text images.

6. Log the live URL in Asana and check off the task



What you already need to know how to do:

- Publish in a CMS. Our clients use Wordpress, Squarespace, and Sierra. If you've used one CMS seriously, you're trainable on the others.

- Edit AI drafts. We use generative AI. Then we make them better. What I need is someone who can read a draft and immediately see what's generic, what's wrong, what's missing, and what someone actually working in that industry would say and then fix all of it.

- Basic on-page SEO. Meta titles and descriptions, headings, internal linking, alt text, and page paths.

- Basic on-page Design. Pick images from the client library, size them correctly, keep it on brand.

- Use Internal Tools: Asana, Canva, Google Sheets, Slack.

- Write clear, professional English
s to clients. Not perfect English. Clear English with a warm and competent tone. Some clients will eventually
 you directly.



You'll love this job if

- A clean checklist and a calendar full of published content is genuinely satisfying to you

- You'd rather be handed systems, templates, and prompts than invent everything from scratch

- You want the same work, the same clients, and the same team every month, not a new gig scramble every 60 days

- You are consistent and reliable



You'll hate this job if:

- You want creative control over topics and voice. Both are set.

- You are against generative AI.

- You go quiet when you're stuck.

- Volume work bores you into sloppiness.

- You're already juggling many different clients and struggling to keep up



What I give you:

- A tested prompt library, you never start from a blank box

- Client assets: logins, photo libraries, brand guidelines

- A Definition of Done checklist built into Asana, so "finished" is never a matter of opinion

- Topics locked before the month begins

- Make the very first word of your message Thursday in all caps. It tells me you read all the way down here.

- A real ramp: We'll start on 8 posts across 3 clients for the first 90 days, then add in the 4th starting month 4.

- A bi-weekly call, and daily availability on slack. 



Pay

Base: $11 USD/hour — about $264/month your first 90 days,  $924/mo after.

Performance Bonus: up to $96/mo first 90 days, $336/month after



The bonus is not a vague "if I'm happy" bonus. It's four components worth an extra $12 per post, reviewed every month, and every one of them is inside your control:



$4 — Drafts, Edits, and Post are completed by deadline

$4 — No missed checklist requirements

$4 — Beat time goal of 3 hours per post



Other terms

- 13th month bonus every December



Part-time and long-term. I'm looking for someone I work with for years, not months.

Paid Monthly via WISE direct to your account



How hiring works

- Post the Application Below

- A short video call

- A paid trial task for one real post

- Offer



How to apply

Don't waste your credits, just bid minimum. I read all replies. 



Answer each of these in your post.



1. A live URL of a post you both wrote and published yourself. Tell me which CMS, roughly when it went live, and what you did on it beyond typing.



2. Show me your editing. Paste one paragraph of raw AI output, then paste your edited version of that same paragraph. Any topic.



3. What hours can you overlap with 8 AM–5 PM Arizona time? Give me the window in both Arizona time and your local time.



4. Your internet: a Speedtest screenshot, and what your backup is when your main connection goes down.



5. Tell me about the worst piece of content you ever had to fix and what was wrong with it.

title: Creative Strategist & GC Creator / Paid Ads Creative Strategist
description:
GO HERE:    
.      com       /      IZCONTENTCREATOR

(Only applications sent here will be processed)



About the Role



We are a growing virtual assistant staffing agency helping U.S. healthcare organizations build reliable remote teams.



We are looking for a Performance Creative Strategist & On-Camera UGC Creator to own the development of paid social creatives from research and concept development through scripting, filming, editing, and performance-driven iteration.



This is not a traditional social media content role.



Your primary objective is to create direct-response ads that generate qualified leads and booked calls at increasingly efficient acquisition costs. Creative decisions should be driven by customer insights and performance data—not aesthetics alone.



You will work closely with our marketing team, receive visibility into creative performance, identify what is and is not working, and use those insights to develop the next generation of ads.



What You'll Own



Creative Strategy & Research



Develop a deep understanding of our target audience, particularly U.S. healthcare owners, administrators, and operational decision-makers.

Research customer pain points, objections, motivations, and buying triggers.

Analyze existing winning and losing creatives to identify repeatable patterns.

Research competitor advertising, Meta Ad Library, organic content, and other sources for new hooks, angles, and concepts.

Develop creatives for different stages of customer awareness, including problem-aware, solution-aware, and product-aware audiences.

Build and maintain a library of winning hooks, angles, formats, and messaging.



Direct-Response Creative Production



Develop approximately 5–10 new ad concepts per week, with multiple hook, angle, or CTA variations where appropriate.

Write compelling hooks designed to capture attention within the first few seconds.

Write complete 30–60 second direct-response video scripts and accompanying shot lists.

Personally appear in UGC-style advertisements, including:

Talking-head videos

Walk-and-talk videos

Demonstration/explainer formats

Testimonial-style creatives

Problem/solution advertisements

Edit or assemble short-form creatives for platforms including Meta, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

Turn successful concepts into multiple creative variations rather than constantly starting from scratch.







Performance & Optimization



You will be expected to understand the performance of your creatives and use that information to determine what should be produced next.









You will:



Review creative performance weekly or biweekly.

Analyze metrics such as:

Thumb-stop / 3-second view rate

Click-through rate (CTR)

Cost per lead (CPL)

Cost per qualified lead

Booked-call performance

Customer acquisition cost (CAC), where applicable

Identify winning and losing hooks, angles, formats, and messaging.

Develop iterations based on performance rather than producing disconnected creative ideas.

Clearly explain the hypothesis behind each new creative test.

Maintain organized creative tagging and documentation so performance patterns can be identified over time.







What Success Looks Like



Success in this role is measured by creative performance and learning velocity.



Within the role, we expect:



A consistent weekly pipeline of new creative concepts and variations.

New creatives that regularly outperform existing benchmarks across engagement, click-through, lead generation, or acquisition efficiency.

At least one new scalable creative winner on a recurring basis.

Clear documentation of winning hooks, angles, objections, and formats.

Increasing reuse and iteration of proven concepts rather than relying entirely on new ideas.

Meaningful insights during creative performance reviews—not simply delivery of finished files.







Required Experience



2+ years of experience creating direct-response paid social advertising, preferably for B2B, service-based, staffing, healthcare, SaaS, or lead-generation businesses.

Demonstrable experience producing creatives specifically designed for paid acquisition—not solely organic social media content.

Strong on-camera presence and confidence delivering UGC-style or talking-head advertisements.

Portfolio demonstrating multiple direct-response video advertisements.

Ability to provide examples of creatives that contributed to improvements in metrics such as:

CPL

CAC

CTR

ROAS

Qualified lead volume

Booked calls

Strong understanding of Meta advertising creative and performance metrics.

Ability to interpret advertising data and translate findings into new creative decisions.

Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, particularly for short-form advertising.

Ability to independently research an audience and develop compelling hooks, angles, and scripts.





Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is a strong advantage:



U.S. healthcare

Virtual assistant or outsourcing services

Staffing and recruitment

B2B lead generation

Professional services

TikTok advertising

YouTube Shorts advertising





Who We're Looking For



Data-Driven



You care about whether an advertisement performs—not simply whether it looks good.





Self-Directed



Once you understand the offer, target audience, brand, and performance data, you can independently research and develop the next batch of creative tests.





High-Output



You understand that paid-social performance requires consistent testing and iteration. You are comfortable producing multiple concepts and variations every week.



Customer-Obsessed

title: Creative Strategist for Scaling DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FIRST: To apply, start your message with the word ANGLE. Applications without it get deleted unread. We do this to find people who actually pay attention to detail.



## About Us



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands (beauty). We move fast, test constantly, and live and die by our ad creative. We're not a corporate agency. You'll work directly with the founder, get quick feedback, and see your concepts go live in real campaigns within days.



## The Role



You'll own the front of the funnel: research → angles → hooks → briefs → iteration. You d
 what we make and why, not just how it's cut. This is performance strategy, not "brand vibes." You're measured on ROAS and CPA, not on how clever a concept sounds in a meeting. You'll turn customer research and competitor teardowns into a steady pipeline of testable ad concepts that actually scale.



## What You'll Do



- Research markets, customers, reviews, and competitors to find the angle

- Write hooks, scripts, and shot-by-shot briefs for editors and UGC creators

- Own the creative testing roadmap — what we test next, and why

- Read the data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and d
 what to double down on or kill

- Turn winners into fresh angles, formats, and variations for testing (not lazy re-cuts)

- Direct editors and creators, and QC that the output matches the concept

- Keep a swipe and insight library so we're never starting from zero



## Must-Haves (track record required)



- 2+ years as a creative strategist for DTC/e-commerce (health/wellness or beauty strongly preferred) with Trackrecord

- You can point to specific winning ads/angles YOU conceived — and the numbers they hit

- Deep direct-response instincts: awareness levels, angles, mechanisms, hooks, offers

- You understand the full funnel — ad → advertorial/VSL/landing page → conversion

- Comfortable reading an ad account and forming a POV, not waiting to be told

- Strong written English — briefs a creator or editor can execute without 10 follow-ups

- High volume and fast iteration don't scare you



## Nice-to-Have



- Hands-on with AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, Topaz, etc.)

- Can rough-cut or storyboard your own concepts

- Worked directly with media buyers on scaling accounts

- Familiar with advertorial and VSL structures



## Hours & Growth



Start at 20 hrs/week. If your angles win and you're reliable, this grows into more hours, a higher rate, and more ownership. We keep good people long-term.



## How to Apply (follow exactly — this is the test)



1. Start your message with ANGLE

2. Link a portfolio or case docs of ads/angles you concepted — concepts + results, not pretty edits you didn't strategize

3. In 3–4 sentences: pick your best-performing angle, the research/insight behind it, why the hook worked, and the result (ROAS / CPA / spend scaled — real numbers)

4. Tell us your process for finding a brand-new angle from scratch

5. List the tools you use (research, briefing, AI, analytics)

6. Confirm your weekly availability and timezone

7. how long youre in Creative Strategy already and track record



Applications that skip any step, hide the numbers, or lead with a generic "I'm hardworking and passionate" intro will not be reviewed.

title: Email Strategist
description:
Momentum Marketing is a done-for-you
 and SMS retention agency for DTC ecommerce brands. We run the full retention engine end-to-end inside Klaviyo, and we back our work with a revenue attribution guarantee. We are direct, numbers-led, and allergic to agency fluff. Our clients pay us to protect their margin while acquisition costs climb, and every
 we send has to earn its place in the inbox.



We are growing, and we are hiring a copywriter who can own the copy for an entire pod of brands.



The Role



You will be the copywriter inside a pod. Each pod manages 5 to 7 brands depending on capacity and pod size, and you own all copy across every flow and campaign for the brands in your pod.



This is not a "write a few
s a week" role. You are the retention copy engine for your pod, and the pod's revenue numbers depend on your output.



What you will do

Build the campaign calendar every single month for each brand in your pod. This is a core, non-negotiable deliverable, not an occasional task.

Write all campaign copy for your pod's brands, mapped to the monthly calendar.

Write all flow copy — Welcome, Abandoned Checkout, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandon, Site Abandon, Post-Purchase, Winback, and Sunset. Post-purchase is where we expect you to be exceptional.

Structure flows strategically inside Klaviyo — you know how to set up the right conditional splits, and how to split based on buyer intent and dollar value. You do not just write copy; you know where each
 sits and why.

Complete all assigned work daily. The role does not run on fixed hours beyond the 10:00 AM daily start, but every task and duty assigned to you must be completed. Output is the measure, not hours logged.

Prerequisite: Supplement Brand Experience (Non-Negotiable)



You must have proven, demonstrable success writing for 7 to 8 figure supplement brands. This is a hard prerequisite, not a preference.



That means you understand supplement buyer psychology at a working level:



Why supplement customers buy, why they lapse, and what actually reactivates them

How to sell repeat purchase and subscription without sounding desperate

How to handle claims, ingredients, and benefits persuasively and responsibly

How to write post-purchase sequences that turn a first order into a second and third



You will be asked to show proof of work. Portfolio pieces from 7-8 figure supplement brands with real performance data (open rates, click rates, revenue attributed). If you cannot show this, please do not apply.



Manual Copywriting Only — No AI



All copy must be written by you, manually. We will know if it is written by AI.



AI copy has a tell: it cannot think, it cannot adapt to a specific region's culture and language, and it cannot make the creative word choices that make an
 feel like it was written by a human who actually understands the customer. We need a writer who can flex tone, reference culture, and choose words that land with a specific audience in a specific market.



If your workflow is "prompt, paste, submit," this role is not for you.



Skills and Knowledge Required

Copywriting: High-converting
 copy is your craft. You can prove it with numbers.

Strategy: Excellent retention strategy knowledge. You can build a monthly calendar that balances promo, content, and lifecycle, and you can explain the reasoning behind every send.

Klaviyo: Strong working knowledge. Flow structure, conditional splits, segmentation by buyer intent and dollar value, and how flow logic connects to copy.

Post-purchase mastery: This is the flow we care about most. You should be able to talk in depth about how you build post-purchase sequences that drive second and third orders.

Cultural and linguistic range: Ability to adapt copy to specific regions, cultures, and language patterns.

The Hiring Process

Application with portfolio and proof of work (7-8 figure supplement brands, with performance data)

Copy test — every candidate completes a test. Details provided to shortlisted applicants.

Interview

Culture and Expectations



Read this section carefully. We take it as seriously as the skills.



Punctuality is critical. Work starts at 10:00 AM daily. Deadlines are deadlines.

Attitude matters as much as talent. If you demonstrate a bad attitude or entitlement that affects the morale of the team, you will be terminated without notice. We mean this.

We help each other. Our culture expects you to support your pod and the wider team. No lone wolves.

Learner's mindset. There is always something you can learn. We expect you to want feedback and act on it.

Hunger. We want ambitious people who want to excel, not people looking to coast.

Compensation

Competitive base salary

Quarterly performance bonus that can exceed a full month's salary — when your pod's brands win, you win

Long-term contract with growth as the agency scales

title: Ecom Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a **skilled e-commerce video editor to join our team long-term** and help us produce high-converting direct-response ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms.



This is **not a one-off project**. We’re looking for someone who wants consistent work, can handle a steady creative workload, and is interested in **growing with the brand over time**.



You should already have experience editing **e-commerce ads**, including formats such as:



* UGC ads

* VSL-style ads

* Mashups

* Native-style ads

* Advertorial/story-driven creatives

* Direct-response product ads



We’ll provide scripts, raw footage, creative direction, and references. Your job is to turn those assets into ads that **grab attention, maintain retention, and drive conversions.**



### Responsibilities



* Edit raw footage into high-converting direct-response ad creatives

* Turn scripts and creative briefs into finished ads

* Create strong, engaging openings that hook viewers within the first few seconds

* Edit UGC, VSLs, mashups, native ads, and other e-commerce creative formats

* Use B-roll, captions, motion graphics, sound effects, music, pattern interrupts, and visual callouts where appropriate

* Match reference ads while also bringing your own creative judgment to the edit

* Create multiple variations of winning concepts when needed

* Make revisions based on feedback and ad performance

* Maintain **fast and consistent turnaround times**

* Communicate clearly and respond quickly



### Requirements



* **Proven experience editing e-commerce/direct-response ads**

* Strong portfolio of paid social ads you have personally edited

* Experience with **UGC, VSLs, mashups, and performance creatives**

* Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention, storytelling, and direct-response editing

* Ability to make an ad feel native to platforms like Meta and TikTok

* Ability to follow detailed creative briefs without needing constant supervision

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* **Fast turnaround — typically 1–3 days depending on the project**

* **Full-time or near full-time availability**

* Ability to handle a consistent volume of creatives every week

* Strong desire to work with us **long-term and grow alongside the brand**



### What We Provide



* Finished scripts and ad angles

* Raw footage and UGC

* Creative briefs

* Reference ads

* Examples of previous winning creatives

* Clear feedback and direction

* Consistent work for the right editor



### Important



We are **not looking for someone whose main focus is making videos look cinematic or pretty.**



These are **performance ads.**



Every editing decision should serve a purpose:



**Hook attention ? maintain retention ? communicate the message ? drive action.**



You should understand how to use pacing, visuals, B-roll, captions, pattern interrupts, emotional moments, and sound design to make someone continue watching.



Most videos will range from approximately **30 seconds to 2 minutes**, although some VSL-style creatives may be longer.



### Long-Term Opportunity



We want to build a relationship with **one or more reliable editors who can become a core part of our creative team.**



If you consistently:



* Deliver quality work

* Hit deadlines

* Communicate well

* Learn from feedback

* Understand direct-response creative

* Help us improve creative output



…there will be **consistent ongoing work and room for greater responsibility as we grow.**

title: Executive Assistant — Operations
description:
Please send 30 second video in loom or screen recording to hear your English.

---



## About the Business



Adam Rapoport is a licensed California real estate agent specializing in **probate real estate** across Southern California, active in the space since 2018. His positioning — *"Where Probate Attorneys Stop, I Start"* — reflects a practice built around the legal and procedural complexity of estate sales: navigating probate court timelines, coordinating with attorneys and executors, managing properties under threat of foreclosure, and closing transactions that most agents are unequipped to handle.



Alongside his brokerage work, Adam operates **Atomic Group Development LLC**, an acquisition and assignment vehicle for estate properties that aren't retail-ready.



This is a **high-volume, detail-intensive, deadline-driven business.** Probate transactions run on court schedules, statutory notice periods, and hard filing deadlines — there is very little room for dropped balls.



---



## Why This Role Exists



Adam is the rainmaker, negotiator, and legal-strategy mind of the business — the parts of the job that require his license, his relationships, and his judgment. Everything *around* those things — the coordination, the tracking, the follow-through, the paperwork choreography — is currently absorbing time and attention that should be going toward selling and prospecting.



The right Executive Assistant takes ownership of the operational engine so Adam can stay focused on the front-of-house work only he can do.



---



## What This Role Owns



**Transaction & Case Coordination**

- Track active probate listings and estate files across multiple courts and counties (currently San Bernardino, with matters spanning multiple case types: foreclosure-threatened sales, ex parte applications, permit verifications)

- Maintain a master status tracker for every active file — key dates, pending actions, outstanding documents, responsible parties

- Monitor statutory and court deadlines (e.g., notice periods, hearing dates, trustee sale dates) and flag upcoming deadlines well in advance

- Coordinate document packages (listing agreements, notice filings, disclosures) between Adam, attorneys, title/escrow, and executors



**CRM & Pipeline Management**

- Own day-to-day operation of GoHighLevel (GHL) — nurture sequences, follow-up tasks, SMS/email campaigns

- Keep PropertyRadar and Vulcan7 lead lists current, organized, and actionable

- Manage lead intake, data hygiene, and follow-up cadences so nothing warm goes cold



**Marketing & Social Media**

- **Build out and manage Adam's social media presence** — this is a growth responsibility, not just maintenance: content calendar, post creation/scheduling, basic graphic/video assembly, captions, and engagement 
, Instagram, and any other relevant platforms)

- Maintain and update the probate marketing suite (pre-listing packages, business cards, SMS/MMS assets, comparison sheets)

- Coordinate with designers/AI tools on revisions using prepared briefs

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profile



**Calendar & Communication**

- Own Adam's calendar with ruthless protection of his early-morning study/prospecting blocks

- Triage inbox and calls; draft routine correspondence for his review (grammar-clean, in his voice — not rewritten)

- Prepare him for calls and meetings with a one-glance briefing



**Document & Systems Management**

- Keep files named, filed, and organized (Google Drive, Glide, CRMLS) using consistent, logical systems

- Manage e-signature workflows (Docusign) — sending, tracking, following up on outstanding signatures



**As the Business Evolves**

- Support additional systems and process build-out as transaction volume grows



---



## What This Role Does *Not* Own



- Client-facing negotiation or advice (Adam's license, Adam's judgment)

- Legal interpretation or filings requiring an attorney

- Final say on marketing voice/positioning — EA executes and maintains, doesn't originate brand strategy



---



## Ideal Candidate Profile



**Non-negotiables**

- **Excellent spoken and written English.** This person will be drafting client- and attorney-facing communication and may occasionally need to speak with US contacts by phone — fluency needs to be strong enough that it's not a barrier or a tell.

- **Extremely organized and deadline-obsessed.** This business runs on court dates and statutory windows. Someone who is "pretty organized" is not enough — this person needs to treat deadlines the way a paralegal or surgical scheduler would.

- **Comfortable with ambiguity and legal/procedural complexity.** Probate isn't formulaic; the right person can hold multiple open threads (a foreclosure postponement, an ex parte hearing, a permit dispute) without losing the plot.

- **Strong written communication.** Will be drafting and cleaning up client- and attorney-facing communication.

- **Social media / content instincts.** Comfortable building out a business page from scratch — not just scheduling posts someone else designed, but having a sense of what makes real estate content engaging.

- **Tech-comfortable, not tech-intimidated.** GHL, PropertyRadar, Vulcan7, Docusign, Google Workspace, CRMLS — willingness to learn systems quickly matters more than prior exposure to these specific tools.

- **Discretion.** This role touches estate, financial, and sometimes sensitive family-conflict information.



**Strongly preferred**

- Prior experience in real estate operations, transaction coordination, or a legal/paralegal support role (probate, estate, or title/escrow experience is a major plus)

- Experience managing a CRM and follow-up sequences, not just data entry

- A track record of *proactively* catching things before they become problems — not just executing assigned tasks



**Working style fit**

- Adam is direct and prefers the honest read over the soft one — this person should be comfortable pushing back, flagging risk, and saying "this deadline is at risk" without waiting to be asked

- Adam iterates from his own drafts; this person edits and polishes rather than overwrites his voice

- Self-directed — Adam's calendar (especially early mornings) is protected, so this isn't a role that leans on constant real-time check-ins



---



## Role Logistics



- **Location:** Philippines-based, fully remote

- **Hours:** 20–30 hrs/week

- **Compensation:** $600/month (flat rate, not hourly — clarify with candidates whether this is fixed regardless of the 20–30 hr range, or scales within it)

- **Schedule:** 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time, worked within that window for a total of 20–30 hrs/week (not necessarily the full 9-hour span every day). In Philippine time, that converts to roughly **10:00 PM – 7:00 AM** (shifting to ~11:00 PM – 8:00 AM once Pacific time falls back to standard time in November) — meaning this is effectively a **night shift** for a PH-based candidate. That's a normal and common shift pattern in the Philippines given the BPO industry, but it's worth stating clearly in the posting so candidates self-select accurately rather than discovering it after being hired.

 how much you work, and every hour you work is paid.



What we’re not:

We’re not a client who invents new instructions every week. There’s a documented SOP, a dashboard, and a supervisor you can message. And we’re not going to micromanage your day — if you’d rather be told exactly when to be online, this isn’t the right fit.



What we filter hardest for:

Self-direction. Not experience, not talent, not a big portfolio. The people who do well here are the ones who get started without being told to.



What you need:



- Any phone that runs Instagram properly

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English good enough for SOPs and team chat



Pay and growth:

We go through the full pay structure with you in the first chat. People who prove reliable over time take on more and earn more — everyone on our team started exactly where you’d start.



How to apply:

Send a message with these three things, in this exact order:



1. How many hours per day you’d like to work, and at what times (your local time)

2. One sentence: what’s the last thing you kept doing consistently without anyone checking on you?

3. The very last line of your message must be: Silver Compass



If any of the three is missing or out of order, we won’t read it. The application is the first part of the job.

What we're looking for:



Fluent, clear spoken English, comfortable holding a natural phone conversation (not reading word-for-word)

Reliable internet, a decent headset, and a quiet space to work

Available for an overlap with Eastern Time business hours (details discussed at interview)



Compensation:



CAD $5.00/hour base pay (~$3.65 USD), paid bi-weekly via Wise

$20 CAD commission per closed deal (demo booked & attended, and deposit received)

2-week paid trial; strong performers move to an ongoing role with room to grow hours and pay



To apply, please include:



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself (we'll send a short script to read)

Your available hours in Philippine Time

Any past cold-calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience

title: Accounting Manager — Month-End Close & Job Costing (US Construction, Night Shift)
description:
Republic Homebuilding and Renovations is a design-build residential

construction and remodeling firm in Webster, Texas, USA, serving

homeowners across the Greater Houston area. We run about ten active

jobs at a time, ranging from $20,000 to $300,000. We use QuickBooks

Online for accounting and JobTread for project management and job

costing.

 

We are hiring one Accounting Manager. This is a fully remote role for

someone based in the Philippines, working United States Central Time

hours.

 

 

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

 

We would rather you rule yourself out now than at offer stage.

 

- This is a night shift, permanently. 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine

  time, Monday to Friday, with one hour unpaid lunch.

- This is a direct engagement with a US company. You would work as an

  independent contractor, not as an employee under Philippine labor

  law. You are responsible for your own taxes and government

  contributions.

- We do NOT provide SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, or HMO. Our pay is set

  above the local market rate specifically because of this. Please

  factor it into your decision.

- This is exclusive and full time. You may not hold another job or

  client engagement while working with us. You will be asked to list

  every current engagement in your application.

- We use screenshot monitoring software on work computers.

 

Pay is $9.00 to $12.00 per hour depending on experience, 40 hours per

week. At today's rate that is roughly PHP 95,700 to PHP 127,500 per

month. Because pay is in US dollars, the peso value moves with the

exchange rate. We also pay a year-end bonus equal to one month's pay,

prorated by month of hire.

 

 

THIS IS NOT A DATA-ENTRY JOB

 

You will own the accounting function.

 

We have separate staff who enter bills, send invoices, chase

documents, and track purchase orders. Your job is to own the close,

own the reconciliations, own the job cost data, and review their work

- not to do it yourself.

 

We are also going to be straightforward about something most job posts

leave out: our historical books need cleanup. Costs have not been

consistently coded to the right jobs, and some accounts need to be

reorganized. Your first ninety days include a defined cleanup project

alongside normal monthly work. You will not be inheriting a clean

system and we are not pretending otherwise.

 

If that is the kind of problem you enjoy, we want to hear from you. If

it sounds like a headache, this is not the right role for you, and

that is fine.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS - ALL FOUR ARE REQUIRED

 

- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

- 3+ years of accounting experience, including at least one year where

  you were personally responsible for closing the books every month.

  Not assisting someone else who closed them.

- Experience assigning costs to specific projects or jobs, including

  d
 which job a cost belongs to at the time you record it

- QuickBooks Online experience

 

 

STRONGLY PREFERRED

 

- Construction, remodeling, or contracting experience, especially US

  residential

- Experience with a project management or job-costing system alongside

  the accounting system (JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, CoConstruct,

  or similar)

- Experience producing a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule using

  percentage-of-completion

- Experience closing books for more than one related entity, including

  intercompany transactions

- QuickBooks Online Advanced Certification / ProAdvisor

- CPA (PRC) license

 

If you do not have every item on the preferred list, apply anyway. The

four requirements above are what matter.

 

 

WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

 

- Reliable high-speed internet AND a reliable backup connection

- Backup power supply

- Reliable computer plus a backup device

- Willingness to use screenshot monitoring software

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 

Monthly close

- Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts every month

- Produce the monthly financial package: profit and loss, balance

  sheet, cash flow statement

- Produce a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule

- Prepare monthly reporting packages required by outside parties

- Close on a published schedule, not "when it gets done"

 

Job costing

- Ensure every cost is coded to the correct job and correct cost type

  at the time it is recorded

- Maintain a clean separation between job costs and company overhead,

  and apply it consistently

- Reconcile job cost data in QuickBooks against JobTread and resolve

  the differences

- Produce per-job cost reporting the project team can rely on

 

Bank feed and payables

- You are the only person who touches the bank feed. Bank feed items

  must be matched to existing bills before they are categorized, never

  entered as new expenses when a bill already exists

- Maintain accounts payable and review vendor bills entered by admin

  staff

- Weekly review for duplicate or miscoded transactions

 

Other

- Run payroll and maintain payroll records

- Maintain the chart of accounts. You are the only person who may add

  or change an account

- Review the work of the admin staff who enter bills and prepare

  invoices

- Reconciliation work extends to two affiliated partnerships in

  addition to the main company

 

 

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 

We measure this role on deliverables, not on time served.

 

- By Day 21: a written month-end close procedure, in your own words,

  that someone else could follow

- By Day 45: first complete set of reconciliations across all bank,

  credit card, and loan accounts

- By Day 75: first complete monthly financial package, delivered on

  schedule

- By Day 90: agreed cleanup milestones met, and job cost data usable

  for estimating

 

 

WHY YOU WILL LIKE WORKING HERE

 

- Real ownership. You are the accounting function, not a task-taker

- A defined problem with a defined finish line, and a company that

  already knows what is broken

- Admin support, so you are not buried in data entry

- Clear hours, clear expectations, deliverables you can point to

- Direct access to the company President. No layers

- Genuine US construction accounting experience: job costing, WIP,

  percentage-of-completion

 

 

OUR HIRING PROCESS

 

1. Application review

2. Short introductory video call

3. Paid two-hour work sample - a real reconciliation and job-costing

   exercise. We pay you at the role's hourly rate for your time

   whether or not we make an offer. Finalists only.

4. Reference check with a direct supervisor from a recent role

5. Offer

 

We do this because we would rather see how you work than hear about

it.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

 

Please apply at our consolidated application form located here: 



Mark

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking an Executive Administrative Assistant to provide dependable, high-level administrative support to the firm's day-to-day operations. This is a part-time position to start, with the potential for expanded hours, responsibilities, and a full-time role as the firm's needs grow.



The position is Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time. We are looking for someone who is interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to keep things organized and moving forward.



This role requires more than simply completing a checklist of assigned tasks. The successful candidate will be able to manage competing priorities, notice details that others may overlook, communicate clearly and professionally, and use good judgment when handling administrative matters. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and can increasingly work independently as they become familiar with the firm.



About the Role



The Executive Administrative Assistant will work closely with the firm's leadership and assist with a variety of administrative, organizational, and operational matters. The position will involve handling both recurring responsibilities and one-off projects, so flexibility and a willingness to learn are important.



Depending on experience and the firm's needs, responsibilities may include:



- Managing and organizing calendars, meetings, and appointments

- Preparing, editing, and formatting correspondence, documents, and other materials

- Drafting routine
s and communications based on instructions or established templates

- Maintaining well-organized electronic files and client-related folders

- Managing documents and information within Google Drive and other cloud-based systems

- Preparing forms, applications, and other administrative materials

- Maintaining spreadsheets, databases, trackers, and internal records

- Reviewing documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting, and consistency

- Conducting internet research and organizing information into useful summaries

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Monitoring deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding administrative items

- Coordinating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties as needed

- Assisting with firm projects, systems, and process improvements

- Following and helping maintain the firm's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Learning new software, systems, and processes as needed

- Providing general administrative support to firm leadership

- Handling other projects and responsibilities as they arise



As you become more familiar with the firm and our operations, we expect the successful candidate to take on greater responsibility and become increasingly proactive in identifying ways to improve efficiency and organization.



What We Are Looking For



The right person will be:



- Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities

- A strong written and verbal communicator in English

- Professional and courteous in all communications

- Able to work independently while knowing when to ask questions

- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what needs to be done

- Willing to learn unfamiliar systems and processes

- Someone who takes ownership of their work and follows tasks through to completion

- Comfortable receiving feedback and continually improving their work



Prior experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, administrative assistant, or in another professional services environment is preferred. Law firm experience is not required, and we are willing to train someone who demonstrates the organizational ability, professionalism, and work ethic we are looking for.



Hours



- Must be available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- Guaranteed 20 hours per week

- Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs develop

- Applicants must be able to consistently work during the stated Eastern Time hours



We are specifically seeking someone interested in a long-term position, rather than someone looking for a short-term or temporary opportunity.



How to Apply



Please follow all of the application instructions below. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, so failure to follow the instructions may result in your application not being considered.



Please include:



- A brief introduction explaining your interest in the position and what makes you well suited for an executive administrative role.

- A summary of your previous administrative, executive assistant, legal, customer service, or professional services experience.

- Your current resume.

- A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video telling us about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in working with our firm.

- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your availability, including confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

- At least five (5) apply points. Applications submitted with fewer than five apply points will not be considered.

- The word DIVISION in the subject line of your application.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted and integral member of our team. If you are highly organized, dependable, comfortable taking initiative, and enjoy supporting a professional environment where no two days are exactly the same, we encourage you to apply.

Previous experience creating or developing online courses

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent organisation and attention to detail

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor (TikTok / Reels / Paid Ads)
description:
I'm a content creator looking for a **short-form video editor** to help edit UGC content and paid ads for brands.



Most videos are **15–60 seconds** and are made for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid social ads.



I'm looking for someone I can work with consistently long-term. If you're good at matching references, understand modern short-form pacing, and pay attention to small details, this should be a great fit.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



You'll mainly be responsible for:



1. Editing raw footage into 15–60 second UGC videos and ads

2. Cutting talking-head footage and mixing in B-roll at the right moments

3. Adding clean captions, text/image overlays, music (very rarely), sound effects, zooms, etc.

4. Matching the pacing and editing style of reference videos I provide

5. Making revisions based on feedback when necessary



Examples of content I've made in the past that I expect you to be able to replicate:





The goal is **clean, engaging, simple, modern short-form content -- NOT overly flashy or over-edited videos.**



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have experience editing TikTok, Reels, UGC, or short-form ads

* Understand pacing, hooks, B-roll placement, and viewer retention

* Be able to closely recreate an editing style from a reference

* Have strong attention to detail

* Communicate reliably and meet deadlines

* Must be able to speak English and preferably use WhatsApp



Experience with **CapCut** is preferred.



Experience editing **UGC or direct-response ads** is a big plus.



WORKFLOW



I'll provide the raw footage, script/context, and reference videos when needed.



Most edits should have a 12–24 hour turnaround time after receiving the footage. Reliability and consistently meeting turnaround times are very important.



The workload will start smaller while we learn each other's workflow, but my goal is to eventually send up to ~2-300 short-form videos per month if we're a good fit.



As we work together, I'd like you to learn my editing style so less direction and fewer revisions are needed over time.



The work schedule is flexible -- there are no strict working hours as long as videos are delivered on time.



There is potential for **consistent, long-term work and more editing volume** if we're a good fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with "UGC EDITOR" so I know you read the entire post.



Then include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. **3–5 of your best short-form video edits** -- please prioritize UGC, TikTok/Reels, or paid ads

3. What editing software you use

4. Your rate (hourly and/or per video)

5. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second video



**Please don't send a huge portfolio. I specifically want to see your best short-form work.**



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **paid test edit** before moving forward.

title: 3D Artist (Blender) — Low-Poly Characters & Animation for Indie Game
description:
About the project



We're using a pipeline similar to Dead Cells: characters and props are modeled, rigged, and animated in low-poly 3D in Blender, then our tools render them out to 2D sprite sheets automatically. So even though the final game is 2D, all of your work happens in 3D.



This means your files need to be clean and consistent — sensible naming, consistent scale, tidy rigs — because our scripts process everything programmatically. If you're the kind of artist who keeps organized scene files, you'll fit right in.



What you'll do

Model low-poly characters, enemies, props, and environment pieces

Rig and animate characters (idle, run, attack, hit, death — the usual game animation set)

Export/render following our pipeline conventions (we'll build the tools with your input)

Help define and document the game's visual style

Give us honest feedback when our ideas won't work visually — we want an artist with opinions

Requirements

Strong Blender skills: modeling, rigging, and keyframe animation

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About the role:



We are a well-established plumbing, heating, cooling and irrigation services company based in Ontario, Canada. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented part-time bookkeeper to work remotely and support our accounts-payable and reconciliation processes in Xero.

This is a long-term, work-from-home position. We expect roughly 20 hours per month to start, with the possibility of additional hours and responsibilities over time as trust is established. You will work closely with our Canadian operations team.



What you will do:



Your core responsibilities will be:

● Accounts payable in Xero — review and approve draft supplier bills that flow in automatically from our capture tool (EzzyBills), ensuring each bill has a valid, approved purchase order.

● Purchase-order checks — confirm that purchase orders raised in our field-service software (Simpro) are approved and complete, and follow up on any that are missing or incomplete.

● Supplier statement reconciliations — reconcile vendor statements against Xero, confirming all bills by vendor have been received, approved and matched to a valid PO. (This is the largest part of the role.)

● Bank & payment matching — match bank-feed deposits and customer payments to the correct transactions in Xero, including cross-referencing customer deposits.

● Credit-card reconciliation — manually review and enter credit-card transactions as required

Over time, the role may expand to include additional bookkeeping and reconciliation duties.

Who we are looking for

● Proven bookkeeping experience, ideally supporting businesses in Canada and/or the US

● Hands-on, confident experience with Xero (required). Experience with SimPro (field service software) is a strong plus

● Comfortable learning and working across multiple cloud software tools — you should pick up new systems quickly.

● Strong understanding of accounts payable, purchase orders, and bank/credit-card reconciliations.

● Excellent attention to detail and accuracy — this role is about catching what's missing or mismatched.

● Good written English and clear, proactive communication

● Reliable internet connection, a suitable home workstation, and availability for occasional overlap with Ontario business hours (Eastern Standard Time) for handoffs and questions.

● Trustworthy and discreet with confidential financial information.



Nice to have:



● Xero certification or other bookkeeping/accounting credentials.

● Experience in a trades, construction, field-service or contracting business.

● Familiarity with Canadian sales tax (HST) treatment on supplier bills.



Details:

● Schedule: Part-time, approximately 20 hours per month to start (flexible; roughly 4–5 hours per week). Potential to grow.

● Location: 100% remote / work-from-home

● Software: Xero, EzzyBills, Simpro, Plooto, BMO online banking (training provided on our specific setup).

● Engagement: Long-term, with a paid trial/onboarding period.



How to apply:

Please reply with (1) a short summary of your bookkeeping experience, (2) resume or CV (3) your desired hourly rate in USD, and (4) your general availability during Ontario (Eastern Time) business hours.

To confirm you've read this posting, please begin your application with the word "Irrigation".

title: Ecommerce Customer Support Specialist (Shopify, Subscriptions) - Long Term, Top Pay
description:
We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand selling consumer health products in the US market. Our business runs on a monthly subscription model, so recurring revenue and customer retention are everything to us.



We keep the brand name off the public posting for competitive reasons. You will get the full picture (brand, product, numbers) on the intro call, and we are happy to sign an NDA if that makes you more comfortable.



What you should know now: we run on Shopify with Loop Subscriptions, our customers are American, volume is scaling every month, and we need someone who can own the inbox properly instead of just clearing tickets.



What you will do



Answer customer
s and messages (order status, shipping, product questions, ingredient and safety questions, usage questions)

Manage subscriptions in Loop: pause, skip, reschedule, swap, cancel, reactivate, fix failed payments

Handle money-back guarantee cases cleanly and fairly

Save subscriptions through genuine problem-solving and sensible retention offers, not pressure

Process refunds, replacements and reshipments in Shopify

Handle chargeback and dispute documentation

Track recurring issues and report them weekly (what customers keep asking, what keeps breaking)

Help build and maintain our macro/canned response library and SOPs



What we need from you



Fluent, natural written English. Not "good enough" English. Our customers are American consumers and your replies must read like they were written by a native speaker. This is non-negotiable and we will test it.

Proven customer support experience with ecommerce brands. Please tell us which brands, which niche, and what your ticket volume was.

Experience with Shopify (orders, refunds, fulfillment) is required

Experience with subscription brands and subscription tools (Loop, Recharge, Skio, Bold or similar) is a strong advantage

Experience with a helpdesk tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Richpanel)

German language skills are a real plus and we pay extra for it (we operate other brands in Europe)

Reliable internet, quiet working environment, and availability that overlaps with US business hours

Health, supplement or wellness niche experience is a bonus



What we offer



Well above the usual rate for this role. We pay for quality and we know what quality costs.

A long-term position. We are not looking for someone for three months. We are looking for the person who still runs our support in two years, with more responsibility and more pay.

Direct communication with the founder, no layers of management.



What we expect in return



We pay very well, and we expect very high performance. That means: fast first-response times, no tickets left sitting, no copy-paste answers that ignore what the customer actually asked, and ownership of the outcome. If you need to be chased for updates, this role is not for you. If you like owning something and being paid properly for it, you will do well here.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Social Media VA (CapCut/Premiere — LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram)
description:
Hi — I'm Eric. I run a small group of US businesses in the medical device space and have a satirical character named Strythrex Guy, and I publish a lot of video. I film it and I write the ideas. I need one person to take the raw footage and turn it into finished, posted content so I can stay focused on creating.



This is a long-term, full-time role. I'm not looking for a project freelancer. I want someone who will still be here in three years, who learns my brands well enough that I stop having to explain things, and who I can pay more as they take on more.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY



- Edit raw footage into vertical short-form video (30-90 seconds) — cuts, pacing, hooks, captions, light B-roll and music

- Reformat one piece of content for three platforms, since a LinkedIn video is not a TikTok

- Schedule and post to LinkedIn, TikTok, and Instagram through a scheduler (Buffer or SocialPilot) on an agreed calendar

- Write simple platform captions from my notes and talking points — I provide the message, you adapt it to the platform

- Keep a clean, organized file system in Google Drive so nothing gets lost

- Send me a short weekly summary of what posted and how it performed



WHAT I NEED YOU TO BE GOOD AT



- Short-form vertical editing. CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut — I care about the result, not the software

- Captions and pacing that hold attention in the first three seconds

- Spoken and written English strong enough for a video call and for writing captions that sound professional to a US business audience

- Following a brief without needing five clarifying questions, and using good judgment when the brief is vague

- Reliability. If you say a video posts Tuesday, it posts Tuesday



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with B2B, professional-services, or executive personal-brand content

- Canva, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Business Center

- Familiarity with Buffer, SocialPilot, Later, or similar



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- Own laptop or desktop (no mobile-only setups), 8GB RAM minimum

- Internet at 20 Mbps or better, with a backup connection

- Able to work at least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern morning hours



WHAT YOU GET FROM ME



- $1,000/month to start, reviewed at 90 days with a raise to $1,200 for strong performance

- 13th-month pay every December

- Paid Philippine holidays and paid time off

- Paid every two weeks via Wise, on time, every time

- Clear briefs and direct feedback. I will not micromanage you



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



1. Put the word "clipboard" as the first word of your reply. Applications without it will not be read.

2. Send three links to vertical short-form videos you personally edited. Tell me which parts were your work.

3. Answer these three questions in your own words (short answers are fine):

   - What editing software do you use, and how long have you used it?

   - Describe a time a client gave you an unclear brief. What did you do?

   - How many hours per week are you currently committed to on other work?

4. Tell me the salary you're looking for and your available start date.



Shortlisted applicants will have a 15-minute video call with me, then a paid $75 test edit on one real clip. I pay for the test whether or not I hire you.
